descriptionByLocale.it:
Gestore account chiave (KAM)

Descrizione Il responsabile del conto chiave (KAM) è responsabile della gestione degli account clienti di Buhler strategicamente importanti. Questa persona deve costruire e mantenere partnership a lungo termine e reciprocamente vantaggiose con tali account chiave. Sarà il principale punto di contatto per tutte le questioni chiave del conto ed è tenuta a comprendere le esigenze del cliente e a collaborare con altre funzioni interne e unità aziendali per garantire che i clienti riescano a raggiungere i loro obiettivi aziendali.

Questa persona dovrebbe anche portare e vendere l'intero portafoglio Buhler applicabile per nuove opportunità commerciali per i loro conti chiave attraverso la vendita incrociata e/o l'upselling prodotti / offerte di servizi.

Responsabilità - Comprendere gli obiettivi aziendali a lungo termine dei clienti, i relativi punti di dolore e individuare opportuni upselling e opportunità di cross-selling. - Sviluppare e mantenere un solido e fiducioso rapporto con i clienti chiave. - Guidare gli sforzi di sviluppo di implementazione e soluzione che meglio rispondono alle esigenze dei clienti, coordinando al contempo il coinvolgimento di tutto il personale aziendale necessario. - Costruire relazioni con i decisori chiave presso l'organizzazione del cliente e capire le dinamiche organizzative interne dei clienti chiave.

- Responsabile per le entrate, la prenotazione degli ordini e la P&L del business dei clienti e la crescita del business. - Condurre un processo di pianificazione strategica congiunta dei conti con i clienti chiave che sviluppano obiettivi di performance reciproci, obiettivi finanziari e pietre miliari critiche. - CultiATE rapporti di consulenza con i clienti, formare rapporti con i clienti a più livelli per fornire un buon servizio, sviluppare future opportunità commerciali, e ottenere rinvii. - Eseguire una revisione completa dei conti almeno trimestrale con i clienti chiave.

- Responsabile dello sviluppo e del raggiungimento delle vendite attraverso il canale di vendita diretta. - Scrivere piani aziendali per tutte le attività di gara d'appalto attuali e di opportunità. - Agire come interfaccia chiave tra il cliente e tutte le divisioni pertinenti. - Gestire e mantenere conti assegnati e conti chiave. - Promuovere le relazioni con i clienti. - Sviluppare e stabilire nuovi account. - Contattare i clienti, raccogliere informazioni, negoziare contratti. - Comunicare e partecipare alla risoluzione di problemi relativi agli ordini o alle preoccupazioni dei clienti.

- Raccogliere dati di mercato (cliente e concorrenza) che mostrano la necessità delle imprese e delle industrie all'interno del territorio. - Rinnovamento continuo / aggiornamento delle conoscenze del prodotto. - Sviluppare la strategia di vendita principale per i suoi conti. - Gestione del budget di vendita. - Lavorare e interagire con l'ingegneria, citando, e personale di contabilità. - Preparare le quotazioni se necessario. - Preparare il report SOM e mantenere il database CRM. - Preparare l'analisi SWOT come necessario per MTP e pianificazione del budget. - Attend e partecipare a fiere, mostre, e associazioni di settore. - Offerta Bühler offline.

- Partecipare a una formazione continua sulle vendite. - Completa rapporti di viaggio e di spesa. - Viaggiare nei siti dei clienti per riunioni personali. - Attend incontri virtuali interni ed esterni con i clienti o discussioni interne Buhler. - Gestire progetti vari e completare vari compiti se necessario.

Requisiti - Laurea in economia o equivalente. - 8+ anni di successo dimostrato nelle vendite di attrezzature di capitale; o una combinazione di formazione ed esperienza. - Microsoft Office richiesto; AutoCAD, Project Wise, D3 preferito; software aziendale, come SAP preferito. - Altamente guidato, con la passione per l'eccellenza nel servizio clienti e la gestione dei clienti con uno stile sicuro assertivo. - Forte rapporto di costruzione, vendite, e competenze negoziali. - Conoscenza tecnica sufficiente dei prodotti da vendere.

- Forte capacità di presentazione, comunicazione scritta e verbale, e capacità interpersonale, capacità di costruire relazioni interpersonali. Esperienza dimostrativa con presentazione a gruppi di vicepresidenti, direttori, manager, clienti, clienti e/o partner di canale.

- Gestione e vendita di grandi conti in situazioni decisionali complesse con esperienza in trattative di grandi e complessi affari con un successo; capacità di navigare attraverso la nostra azienda e il cliente in un approccio consulente/consultativo di fiducia; e, stabilendo rapidamente credibilità con dirigenti di alto livello in tutte le organizzazioni. - Demostra la leadership come un modello di ruolo efficace per il dipartimento in compiti sia interni che esterni all'azienda.

- Ottime capacità di comunicazione interpersonale e di relazione per costruire capacità di lavorare efficacemente con una varietà di persone e personalità; in grado di comunicare in modo chiaro ed efficace in persona e per iscritto internamente ed esternamente. - Deve essere in grado di lavorare sotto pressione. - Capacità di lavorare con supervisione minima e prendere decisioni in modo indipendente, efficace e creativo all'interno delle linee guida aziendali stabilite. - Comprende la natura riservata delle informazioni organizzative e dei dipendenti e osserva la riservatezza.

- Lavora come un giocatore di squadra proattivo con un approccio di proprietà al lavoro; comprende l'importanza di sostenere l'azienda, i suoi membri, ei loro clienti. - Forte capacità organizzative e la capacità di pianificare, dare priorità, coordinare, delegare e gestire il lavoro contemporaneamente. - Capacità di identificare, valutare, risolvere problemi, e dare direzione per quanto riguarda le risoluzioni dei problemi per i singoli e le questioni aziendali. - Mantiene la disciplina, raccomandando e amministrando azioni correttive secondo la politica e le procedure aziendali. - Avanzate competenze MS Office: Excel, Word, PowerPoint, e Outlook.

- Presenta informazioni, analisi e idee per iscritto in modo chiaro e conciso; parla chiaramente in modo che gli altri possano ascoltare e capire ciò che viene detto. - Parla e capisce l'inglese. - Viaggi domestici e internazionali 60% del tempo che può includere lunghe ore e orari di lavoro non tradizionali.

Quello che offriamo - Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo ogni giorno che è stato prodotto con le attrezzature Bühler. Un miliardo di persone guidano veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte con le nostre macchine. - Bühler mira a bilanciare l'umanità, la natura e l'economia in ogni decisione, in quanto sviluppa soluzioni che sbloccano opportunità di business sostenibili nelle industrie globali di cibo, mangimi e mobilità. - Ci sforziamo di creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con una particolare attenzione per soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili.

Pertanto, collaboriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e mondo accademico per accelerare l'impatto insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
The key account manager (KAM) is responsible for handling Buhler's strategically important client accounts This person must build and maintain long-term, mutually beneficial partnerships with such key accounts. S/he will be the main point of contact for all key account matters and is required to understand the client's needs and collaborate with other internal functions and business units to ensure that clients succeed in achieving their business objectives. This person is also expected to bring in and sell the full applicable Buhler portfolio for new business opportunities for their key accounts by cross selling and/or upselling products/service offerings.

Aufgaben:
• Understand key customers' long-term business goals, associated pain points and identify suitable upselling and cross-selling opportunities.

• Develop and maintain a solid and trusting relationship with key accounts.

• Lead the implementation and solution development efforts that best address customer needs, while coordinating the involvement of all necessary company personnel.

• Build relationship with key decision makers at customer organization and understand the internal organizational dynamics of key customers.

• Responsible for revenue, order booking and P&L of the client business and growing the business.

• Lead a joint strategic account planning process with key customers that develops mutual performance objectives, financial targets, and critical milestones.

• Cultivate consulting relationships with customers, form customer relationships at multiple levels to provide good service, develop future business opportunities, and gain referrals.

• Conduct comprehensive account review at least quarterly with key customers.

• Responsible for the development and achievement of sales through the direct sales channel.

• Write business plans for all current and opportunity tender business.

• You will act as the key interface between the customer and all relevant divisions.

• Manages and maintains assigned accounts and key accounts. Fosters customer relationships.

• Develops and establishes new accounts.

• Customer contact, collecting information, negotiating contracts.

• Communicates and participates in solving problems related to customer orders or concerns.

• Collects market data (customer and competition) that show the need of the businesses and industries within the territory.

• Continuous refreshing/updating of product knowledge.

• Develops main business sales strategy for his/her accounts.

• Sales budget management.

• Works and interacts with engineering, quoting and accounting personnel.

• Prepares quotes as needed

• Prepares SOM report and maintains CRM database.

• Prepares SWOT analysis as needed for MTP and budget planning.

• Attends and participates in tradeshow, exhibitions and industry associations.

• Attends Bühler sales seminars.

• Participates in continuous sales training.

• Completes trip reports and expense reports.

• Travels to customer site for in person meetings.

• Attends internal and external virtual meetings with customers or Buhler internal discussions.

• Manages miscellaneous projects and completes various tasks as needed.

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree in business or equivalent.

• 8+ year's proven success in capital equipment sales; or a combination of education and experience.

• Microsoft Office required; AutoCAD, Project Wise, D3 preferred; enterprise software, such as SAP preferre.

• Highly driven, with passion for excellence in customer service and customer management with a confident assertive style.

• Strong relationship building, sales and negotiating skills.

• Sufficient technical knowledge of products to be sold.

• Strong presentation skills, written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills, ability to build interpersonal relationships. Demonstrated experience with presenting to groups of vice presidents, directors, managers, clients, customers and/or channel partners.

• Previous large account management and selling in complex decision-making situations with experience in large complex deal negotiations with a successful track record; ability to navigate across our company and the customer in a trusted advisor/consultative approach; and, establishing credibility quickly with senior level executives across the organizations.

• Demonstrates leadership as an effective role model for the department in tasks both internal and external to the company.

• Excellent interpersonal communication skills and relationship building skills to effectively work with a variety of people and personalities; able to communicate clearly and effectively in person and in writing internally and externally.

• Must be able to work under pressure.

• Ability to work with minimal supervision and make decisions independently, effectively, and creatively within established company guidelines.

• Understands confidential nature of organizational and employee information and observes confidentiality.

• Works as a proactive team player with an ownership approach to work; understands the importance of supporting the company, its members and their customers

• Strong organizational skills and an ability to plan, prioritize, coordinate, delegate, and manage work simultaneously.

• Ability to identify, evaluate, problem solve, and give direction regarding problem resolutions for individual and company issues.

• Maintains discipline, recommending and administering corrective action according to company policy and procedures.

• Advanced MS Office skills: Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

• Presents information, analysis, and ideas in writing in a clear and concise manner; speaks clearly so that others can hear and understand what is being said.

• Speaks and understands English.

• Domestic and international travel 60% of time which may include long hours and non-traditional work schedules.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Schlüsselkontomanager (KAM)

Beschreibung Der Key Account Manager (KAM) ist für die Bearbeitung der strategisch wichtigen Kundenkonten von Buhler verantwortlich. Diese Person muss langfristige, sich gegenseitig vorteilhafte Partnerschaften mit solchen Key Accounts aufbauen und pflegen. S/er wird der wichtigste Ansprechpartner für alle wichtigen Kontoangelegenheiten sein und ist verpflichtet, die Bedürfnisse des Kunden zu verstehen und mit anderen internen Funktionen und Geschäftseinheiten zusammenzuarbeiten, um sicherzustellen, dass Kunden ihre Geschäftsziele erreichen.

Diese Person wird auch erwartet, dass sie das gesamte anwendbare Buhler-Portfolio für neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten für ihre Key Accounts durch Cross-Selling und/oder Upselling Produkte/Service-Angebote einbringt und verkauft.

Verantwortung - Verstehen Sie die langfristigen Geschäftsziele der Schlüsselkunden, damit verbundene Schmerzpunkte und identifizieren Sie geeignete Möglichkeiten für den Upselling und Crossselling. - Entwickeln und pflegen Sie eine solide und vertrauensvolle Beziehung mit Key Accounts. - Führen Sie die Implementierungs- und Lösungsentwicklungsbemühungen, die Kundenbedürfnisse am besten bedienen, während Sie die Einbeziehung aller notwendigen Mitarbeiter des Unternehmens koordinieren. - Aufbauen Sie Beziehungen mit wichtigen Entscheidungsträgern in der Kundenorganisation und verstehen Sie die interne organisatorische Dynamik der Schlüsselkunden.

- Führen Sie einen gemeinsamen strategischen Account-Planungsprozess mit Schlüsselkunden, die gegenseitige Leistungsziele, finanzielle Ziele und kritische Meilensteine entwickelt. - Cultivate Consulting-Beziehungen mit Kunden, bilden Kundenbeziehungen auf mehreren Ebenen, um einen guten Service zu bieten, entwickeln zukünftige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und gewinnen Empfehlungen. - Führen Sie umfassende Account-Review mindestens vierteljährlich mit wichtigen Kunden.

- Verantwortlich für die Entwicklung und die Erreichung des Umsatzes über den direkten Vertriebskanal. - Schreiben Sie Geschäftspläne für alle aktuellen und Gelegenheits-Tendergeschäft. - Handeln Sie als die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen dem Kunden und allen relevanten Abteilungen. - Verwalten und pflegen zugewiesene Konten und Key Accounts. Förderung der Kundenbeziehungen. - Entwickeln und etablieren Sie neue Konten. - Kundenkontakt, Sammeln von Informationen, Verhandlungsverträge. - Kommunizieren und an der Lösung von Problemen im Zusammenhang mit Kundenaufträgen oder Bedenken teilnehmen.

- Sammeln Sie Marktdaten (Kunden und Wettbewerb), die die Notwendigkeit der Unternehmen und Branchen in dem Gebiet zeigen. - Kontinuierliche Aktualisierung / Aktualisierung des Produktwissens. - Entwicklung der wichtigsten Geschäft Verkaufsstrategie für seine / ihre Konten. - Vertriebsbudget-Management. - Arbeit und Interaktion mit Engineering, Zitation, und Buchhaltung Personal. - Bereiten Sie Angebote wie nötig. - Bereiten Sie SOM Bericht und Wartung CRM-Datenbank. - Bereiten SWOT-Analysen, wie für MTP und Budget-Planung erforderlich. - Teilnahme und Teilnahme an Messen, Ausstellungen und Industrieverbänden. - Teilnahme Bühler Verkaufsseminare.

- Teilnahme an der kontinuierlichen Vertriebsschulung. - Vollständige Reiseberichte und Kostenberichte. - Reisen Sie zu Kunden-Websites für persönliche Treffen. - Besuchen Sie interne und externe virtuelle Treffen mit Kunden oder Buhler interne Diskussionen. - Verwalten Sie verschiedene Projekte und erledigen Sie verschiedene Aufgaben nach Bedarf.

Voraussetzungen - Bachelor-Abschluss in Wirtschaft oder gleichwertig. - 8 Jahre bewährten Erfolg im Verkauf von Kapitalanlagen; oder eine Kombination aus Bildung und Erfahrung. - Microsoft Office erforderlich; AutoCAD, Project Wise, D3 bevorzugt; Enterprise-Software, wie SAP bevorzugt. - Hochgetrieben, mit Leidenschaft für Exzellenz in Kundenservice und Kundenmanagement mit einem selbstbewussten Stil. - Starke Beziehungsaufbau, Vertrieb und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten. - Ausreichende technische Kenntnisse der Produkte zu verkaufen.

- Starke Präsentation Fähigkeiten, schriftliche und verbale Kommunikation, und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten, die Fähigkeit, zwischenmenschliche Beziehungen aufzubauen. Vorgestellte Erfahrung mit der Präsentation an Gruppen von Vizepräsidenten, Direktoren, Manager, Kunden, Kunden und / oder Channel-Partner.

- Frühere große Kontoführung und Verkauf in komplexen Entscheidungssituationen mit Erfahrung in großen komplexen Deal Verhandlungen mit einer erfolgreichen Erfolgsbilanz; Fähigkeit, durch unser Unternehmen und den Kunden in einem vertrauenswürdigen Berater/Beratung Ansatz navigieren; und, Glaubwürdigkeit schnell mit Führungskräften auf hoher Ebene in den Organisationen zu etablieren. - Demonstration Führung als effektives Vorbild für die Abteilung in Aufgaben sowohl intern als auch extern zum Unternehmen.

- Ausgezeichnete zwischenmenschliche Kommunikation Fähigkeiten und Beziehungsaufbau Fähigkeiten effektiv mit einer Vielzahl von Menschen und Persönlichkeiten arbeiten; in der Lage, klar und effektiv in Person und schriftlich intern und extern kommunizieren. - Muss in der Lage sein, unter Druck arbeiten. - Fähigkeit, mit minimaler Aufsicht zu arbeiten und Entscheidungen unabhängig, effektiv und kreativ innerhalb etablierter Unternehmen Richtlinien zu treffen. - Versteht den vertraulichen Charakter von Organisations-und Mitarbeiterinformationen und beachtet Vertraulichkeit.

- Funktioniert als proaktiver Teamplayer mit einem Ownership-Ansatz zur Arbeit; versteht die Bedeutung der Unterstützung des Unternehmens, seiner Mitglieder und ihrer Kunden. - Starke organisatorische Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, die Arbeit gleichzeitig zu planen, zu priorisieren, zu koordinieren, zu delegieren und zu verwalten. - Fähigkeit, zu identifizieren, zu bewerten, zu lösen und zu geben Richtung in Bezug auf Problemlösungen für individuelle und betriebliche Fragen. - Pflegen Disziplin, Empfehlung und Verwaltung von Korrekturmaßnahmen nach Unternehmenspolitik und Verfahren. - Erweiterte MS Office Fähigkeiten: Excel, Word, PowerPoint, und Outlook.

- Präsentiert Informationen, Analysen und Ideen schriftlich in einer klaren und prägnanten Weise; spricht klar, so dass andere hören und verstehen, was gesagt wird. - Spricht und versteht Englisch. - Inländische und internationale Reisen 60% der Zeit, die lange Stunden und nicht-traditionelle Arbeitszeiten umfassen kann.

Was wir bieten - täglich essen zwei Milliarden Menschen Lebensmittel, die mit Bühler-Geräten hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen fahren Fahrzeuge, deren Teile mit unseren Maschinen hergestellt wurden. - Bühler zielt darauf ab, Mensch, Natur und Wirtschaft in jeder Entscheidung zu balancieren, indem es Lösungen entwickelt, die nachhaltige Geschäftschancen in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen. - Wir streben Innovationen für eine bessere Welt mit einem besonderen Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen an.

Daher arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Unternehmen und Hochschulen zusammen, um gemeinsam die Wirkung zu beschleunigen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Gestionnaire de comptes clés (KAM)

Description Le gestionnaire de compte principal (GAM) est responsable du traitement des comptes clients stratégiques importants de Buhler. Cette personne doit établir et maintenir des partenariats à long terme et mutuellement avantageux avec ces comptes clés. Il sera le principal point de contact pour toutes les questions de compte clés et doit comprendre les besoins du client et collaborer avec d'autres fonctions internes et unités opérationnelles pour s'assurer que les clients réussissent à atteindre leurs objectifs opérationnels.

Cette personne devrait également présenter et vendre le portefeuille Buhler complet applicable pour de nouvelles occasions d'affaires pour ses comptes clés en vendant et/ou en vendant des produits/services.

Responsabilités - Comprendre les objectifs commerciaux à long terme des clients clés, les points de douleur associés et identifier les occasions de vente et de vente croisée appropriées. - Développer et maintenir une relation solide et fiable avec les comptes clés. - Diriger les efforts de mise en oeuvre et de développement de solutions qui répondent le mieux aux besoins des clients, tout en coordonnant la participation de tout le personnel nécessaire de l'entreprise. - Établir des relations avec les décideurs clés de l'organisation cliente et comprendre la dynamique organisationnelle interne des clients clés.

- Mener un processus de planification stratégique des comptes conjoint avec les clients clés qui élabore des objectifs de rendement mutuel, des objectifs financiers et des jalons critiques. - Cultivat des relations de consultation avec les clients, établir des relations avec les clients à plusieurs niveaux afin de fournir un bon service, de développer des occasions d'affaires futures et de faire des renvois. - Mener une revue complète des comptes au moins tous les trimestres avec les clients clés.

- Ecrire des plans d'affaires pour toutes les activités courantes et les offres d'offres. - Agir comme interface clé entre le client et toutes les divisions pertinentes. - Gérer et maintenir les comptes assignés et les comptes clés. - Favoriser les relations avec les clients. - Développer et établir de nouveaux comptes. - Communiquer avec le client, recueillir des informations, négocier des contrats. - Communiquer et participer à la résolution des problèmes liés aux commandes ou aux préoccupations du client.

- Collecter des données de marché (client et concurrence) qui montrent les besoins des entreprises et des industries sur le territoire. - Actualisation continue des connaissances sur les produits. - Développer la stratégie de vente commerciale principale pour ses comptes. - Gestion du budget des ventes. - Travailler et interagir avec le personnel de l'ingénierie, de la citation et de la comptabilité. - Préparer l'assaisonnement au besoin. - Préparer le rapport SOM et tenir à jour la base de données CRM. - Préparer l'analyse SWOT au besoin pour le MTP et la planification budgétaire. - Participer aux salons, expositions et associations industrielles. - Participer aux séminaires de vente Bühler.

- Participer à des activités de formation continue en matière de vente. - Remplir des rapports de voyage et des rapports de dépenses. - Se rendre sur les sites des clients pour des réunions en personne. - Assister à des réunions virtuelles internes et externes avec les clients ou des discussions internes de Buhler. - Gérer divers projets et accomplir diverses tâches au besoin.

Exigences - Baccalauréat en affaires ou équivalent. - 8 ans et plus de succès prouvé dans les ventes d'équipement; ou une combinaison d'éducation et d'expérience. - Microsoft Office requis; AutoCAD, Projet Wise, D3 préféré; logiciel d'entreprise, comme SAP préféré. - Très motivé, avec passion pour l'excellence dans le service à la clientèle et la gestion de la clientèle avec un style confiant. - Forte relation de construction, de vente et de négociation compétences. - Connaissances techniques suffisantes des produits à vendre.

- Des compétences de présentation, de communication écrite et verbale, et de relations interpersonnelles, de renforcement des relations interpersonnelles. Expérience démontrée de la présentation aux groupes de vice-présidents, directeurs, gestionnaires, clients, clients et/ou partenaires de canaux.

- La gestion de comptes importants et la vente dans des situations de prise de décisions complexes avec l'expérience dans les négociations complexes avec un succès de transactions; la capacité de naviguer dans notre entreprise et le client dans une approche de confiance conseiller/consultative; et, l'établissement rapide de la crédibilité avec les cadres supérieurs dans les organisations. - Démontre le leadership comme modèle efficace pour le ministère dans les tâches internes et externes à l'entreprise.

- Excellentes compétences en communication interpersonnelle et en relations pour travailler efficacement avec une variété de personnes et de personnalités; capables de communiquer clairement et efficacement en personne et par écrit à l'interne et à l'externe. - Doit pouvoir travailler sous pression. - Capacité de travailler avec une supervision minimale et de prendre des décisions de façon indépendante, efficace et créative dans le cadre des lignes directrices établies par l'entreprise. - Comprendre la nature confidentielle des informations organisationnelles et des informations sur les employés et observer la confidentialité.

- Fonctionne comme un acteur d'équipe proactif avec une approche de propriété du travail; comprend l'importance de soutenir l'entreprise, ses membres et leurs clients. - Des compétences organisationnelles solides et une capacité de planifier, prioriser, coordonner, déléguer et gérer simultanément le travail. - Capacité de repérer, évaluer, résoudre des problèmes et donner des orientations concernant les solutions de problèmes pour les questions individuelles et d'entreprise. - Maintient la discipline, recommande et administre les mesures correctives conformément à la politique et aux procédures de l'entreprise. - Compétences avancées de MS Office : Excel, Word, PowerPoint et Outlook.

- Présente l'information, l'analyse et les idées par écrit de façon claire et concise; parle clairement pour que d'autres puissent entendre et comprendre ce qui est dit. - parle et comprend l'anglais. - Voyages intérieurs et internationaux 60 % du temps qui peut comprendre de longues heures et des horaires de travail non traditionnels.

Ce que nous offrons - Deux milliards de personnes mangent chaque jour des aliments produits avec des équipements Bühler. Un milliard de personnes conduisent des véhicules dont les pièces ont été fabriquées avec nos machines. - Bühler vise à équilibrer l'humanité, la nature et l'économie dans chaque décision en développant des solutions qui permettent de débloquer des opportunités d'affaires durables dans les industries mondiales de l'alimentation, de l'alimentation animale et de la mobilité. - Nous nous efforçons de créer des innovations pour un monde meilleur, en mettant l'accent sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables.

Nous faisons donc équipe avec nos clients, nos start-ups, nos multinationales et notre milieu universitaire pour accélérer l'impact ensemble.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Aufgaben:
Apoiar as atividades de planejamento, controle e programação da produção, acompanhando estoques de materiais e ordens de fabricação para assegurar o melhor aproveitamento dos recursos e o cumprimento dos prazos. Também será responsável por dar suporte ao cadastro e à atualização dos roteiros de produção, contributorindo para a melhoria contínua, organização e e eficiência dos processos produtivos.

Anforderungen:
Realizar a programação de reprocesso de máquinas e a programação das máquinas semanais e controlar o inventário de peças, conjuntos e máquinas da produção;
• Realizar a programação dos conjuntos solicitados pela Assistência Técnica, como tambam o controle da entrega. Elaborar relatórios menlais referentes ao fechamento de máquinas. (Máquinas Prontas, Semiabadas e em Produção)

• Verificar periodicamente o aproveitamento/eficiência de mão-de-obra, corrigindo distorções que houver na alimentação de dados nos programas utilizados pela produção. (z. B. Interferencias, Retrabalho);

• Gerar e analisar informacições da necessidade de materiais para a fabricação de máquinas e conjuntos;

descriptionByLocale.it:
Come parte del Gruppo Bühler attivo a livello mondiale, Bühler Leybold Optics è uno dei leader di mercato per sistemi di rivestimento sottovuoto ad alta tecnologia. Da oltre 150 anni sviluppiamo soluzioni innovative per il rivestimento di vetro architettonico, lenti per occhiali e componenti ottici per smartphone, veicoli e tecnologia medica.

In qualità di dipendente (m/f/d) Servizio degli interni di vendita / Supporto vendite, supporti il team di vendita e la gestione divisionale con offerte, calcoli e documenti di progetto. Con il vostro metodo di lavoro strutturato, assicurate processi efficienti e accompagnate i progetti internazionali del cliente amministrativamente. Entra a far parte della Bühler Alzenau GmbH! Facciamo la differenza insieme a Bühler! Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte utilizzando le tecnologie Bühler.
Vogliamo creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più veloce insieme. Compiti: • Creano, revisionano e verificano la plausibilità dei calcoli e delle offerte per progetti di impianti internazionali. • Essi raccolgono informazioni e requisiti dalle nostre vendite e aree specializzate in tutto il mondo in modo strutturato e creano una base di fornitura affidabile. • Essi sostengono i nostri clienti in tutto il mondo durante il processo di offerta e sono a loro disposizione come persona di contatto competente. • Coordinate il coordinamento interno con l'ingegneria, l'acquisto, la gestione del progetto e il servizio e quindi sostenete il team di vendita nella preparazione dell'offerta. • Garantiscono un budget completo e corretto per il progetto. • L'utente assume compiti amministrativi e organizzativi nell'ufficio vendite e supporta la gestione del dipartimento in valutazioni, presentazioni e report. Requisiti • Hanno completato la formazione commerciale o tecnica, idealmente completato da ulteriore formazione come tecnico, economista aziendale o una qualifica simile. • Porti la tua prima esperienza professionale nel supporto vendite, nel servizio interno di vendita, nella preparazione di offerte o in una funzione paragonabile. • Idealmente, hai già lavorato con strumenti di citazione, calcolo, CRM o configurazione del prodotto e hai una buona comprensione tecnica e commerciale. • Sei sicuro nel trattare con MS Office; La conoscenza di SAP è un vantaggio. • Grazie alle vostre buone competenze linguistiche in inglese, è possibile comunicare in modo sicuro con i clienti internazionali, nonché le vendite e le aree specialistiche in tutto il mondo. • Un modo sistematico, strutturato e attento di lavorare, oltre a forti capacità di comunicazione e coordinamento, vi distingue. • Iniziativa, affidabilità, lavoro di squadra e divertimento di lavorare insieme in un ambiente internazionale completano il tuo profilo. Offriamo: Sviluppo professionale e personale Offriamo una vasta gamma di opportunità di apprendimento, come video, formazione online, formazione faccia a faccia e webinar con formati brevi, rilevanti, coinvolgenti, personalizzati e mobili. Mensa con pasti sani Godetevi pasti sani nella nostra mensa a prezzi equi. Eventi e eventi di squadra Il vostro impegno ci rende possibile. Vogliamo festeggiare insieme a te. Le nostre feste di Natale, feste estive, eventi sportivi e eventi di squadra offrono le migliori opportunità per farlo. Posto di lavoro moderno con le migliori attrezzature tecniche Lavorare in un luogo di lavoro moderno dotato degli ultimi strumenti tecnici per aumentare la produttività e l'innovazione. Cultura aziendale familiare Abbiamo più di 160 anni di storia. Questo ci rende una società che pensa e investe a lungo termine – in innovazione, i nostri dipendenti e il successo economico. Vantaggi e sconti dei dipendenti Godetevi una varietà di vantaggi e sconti per i dipendenti che rendono la vostra vita quotidiana più facile. Diventa parte della nostra squadra e scopri di più. Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo prodotto nelle piante di Bühler ogni giorno. Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte utilizzando le tecnologie Bühler. Con ogni decisione, Bühler persegue l'obiettivo di conciliare le esigenze dell'economia, delle persone e della natura. In questo modo, sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. Vogliamo innovare per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più veloce insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
As part of the globally active Bühler Group, Bühler Leybold Optics is one of the market leaders for high-tech thin-film vacuum coating systems. For more than 150 years, we have been developing innovative solutions for the coating of architectural glass, spectacle lenses and optical components for smartphones, vehicles and medical technology.

As an employee (m/f/d) Sales Interior Service / Sales Support, you support the sales team and divisional management with offers, calculations and project documents. With your structured working method, you ensure efficient processes and accompany international customer projects administratively. Become part of Bühler Alzenau GmbH!

Let us make a difference together at Bühler!
Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together. Tasks: • They create, revise and verify the plausibility of calculations and offers for international plant projects. • They bring together information and requirements from our worldwide sales and specialist areas in a structured manner and create a reliable supply basis. • They support our customers worldwide during the offer process and are at their disposal as a competent contact person. • You coordinate the internal coordination with engineering, purchasing, project management and service and thus support the sales team in the preparation of the offer. • They ensure complete and proper project budgeting. • You take on administrative and organizational tasks in the Sales Back Office and support the department management in evaluations, presentations and reports. Requirements • They have completed commercial or technical training, ideally supplemented by further training as a technician, business economist or a comparable qualification. • You bring your first professional experience in sales support, sales internal service, in the preparation of offers or in a comparable function. • Ideally, you have already worked with quotation, calculation, CRM or product configuration tools and have a good technical and commercial understanding. • You are safe in dealing with MS Office; Knowledge of SAP is an advantage. • Thanks to your good English language skills, you can communicate securely with international customers as well as worldwide sales and specialist areas. • A systematic, structured and careful way of working as well as strong communication and coordination skills set you apart. • Initiative, reliability, teamwork and enjoyment of working together in an international environment round off your profile. We offer: Professional and personal development We offer a wide range of learning opportunities, such as videos, online training, face-to-face training and webinars with short, relevant, engaging, personalised and mobile formats. Canteen with healthy meals Enjoy healthy meals in our canteen at fair prices. Team events and events Your commitment makes it possible for us. We want to celebrate this together with you. Our Christmas parties, summer parties, sporting events and team events offer the best opportunities to do so. Modern workplace with the best technical equipment Work in a modern workplace equipped with the latest technical tools to boost your productivity and innovation. Family business culture We have more than 160 years of history. This makes us a company that thinks and invests in the long term – in innovation, our employees and economic success. Employee benefits and discounts Enjoy a variety of employee benefits and discounts that make your everyday life easier. Become part of our team and find out more. With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries. We want to innovate for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

Nous offrons: Développement professionnel et personnel Nous offrons un large éventail d'opportunités d'apprentissage, telles que des vidéos, des formations en ligne, des formations face à face et des webinaires avec des formats courts, pertinents, attrayants, personnalisés et mobiles. Cantine avec des repas sains Profitez de repas sains dans notre cantine à des prix équitables. Manifestations et événements en équipe Votre engagement nous rend possibles. Nous voulons fêter ça avec vous. Nos fêtes de Noël, les fêtes d'été, les événements sportifs et les événements en équipe offrent les meilleures occasions de le faire. Un lieu de travail moderne avec le meilleur équipement technique Travaillez dans un lieu de travail moderne équipé des derniers outils techniques pour stimuler votre productivité et votre innovation. Culture des entreprises familiales Nous avons plus de 160 ans d'histoire. Cela fait de nous une entreprise qui pense et investit à long terme – dans l'innovation, nos employés et la réussite économique. C'est pourquoi nous travaillons avec les clients, les start-up, les multinationales et les scientifiques pour obtenir un impact plus rapide ensemble.

Ciò include una stretta adesione alle direttive interne di Bühler e agli standard ambientali, sanitari e di sicurezza (EHS).

Aufgaben:
• Esecuzione dei lavori di ingegneria degli impianti e/o delle macchine nell'ambito dei progetti

• Partecipa attivamente a Project Reviews o Project Meetings se richiesto Support Project Manager per garantire una corretta esecuzione del progetto secondo il processo di Bühler Project Management.

• Disegnare layout efficienti, organizzati e pratici per impianti di produzione e linee di produzione. L'obiettivo principale è quello di progettare un layout di impianto che ottimizza il flusso dei materiali, garantisce standard di sicurezza e massimizza l'uso dello spazio.

• Risolvere domande o problemi che si verificano durante la progettazione e produzione, nonché durante l'installazione e la messa in servizio con il supporto di un Project Manager

• Traccia gli orari per garantire che le sue parti dei progetti siano eseguite completamente e in tempo. Priorizzare e gestire le ore di lavoro per sostenere le ore di bilancio e le date previste per i progetti

Anforderungen:
• Laureato in ingegneria meccanica o corso relativo

• Know-how di base nello strumento CAD

• Proficienza nella lingua inglese

• Comprensione dei principi di fabbricazione

• Buone capacità interpersonali e di lavoro di squadra

• Buone capacità di problem solving

Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo ogni giorno che è stato prodotto con attrezzature Bühler. Un miliardo di persone guidano veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte con le nostre macchine.
Bühler si propone di bilanciare l'umanità, la natura e l'economia in ogni decisione, sviluppando soluzioni che sbloccano opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale.
Ci sforziamo di creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con un focus speciale su soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Pertanto, ci impegniamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e accademia per accelerare l'impatto insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Deliver comprehensive plant design engineering services, ensuring all project components are supplied within the established timeline and adhere to the required quality standards. This includes strict adherence to Bühler's internal directives as well as Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) standards.

Aufgaben:
• Execution of plant and/or machine engineering work within the scope of projects

• Actively participate in Project Reviews or Project Meetings if required Support Project Manager to ensure a proper project execution according the Bühler Project Management process.

• Draw efficient, organized, and practical layouts for manufacturing plants, and production lines. The main objective is to design a plant layout that optimizes the flow of materials, ensures safety standards, and maximizes the use of space.

• Resolve questions or problems that occur during the design and manufacturing as well as during installation and commissioning with support of a Project Manager

• Track schedules to ensure his parts of the projects are executed completely and on time. Prioritise and manage work hours to support budgeted hours and scheduled due dates for projects

Anforderungen:
• Graduate of Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related course

• Basic know-how in CAD tool

• Proficiency in the English language

• Understanding of manufacturing principles

• Good interpersonal and teamwork skills

• Good problem solving skills

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

Bühler Leybold Optics è sinonimo di tecnologie innovative e crescita costante. Nell'ambito del Gruppo Bühler, un gruppo di ingegneria globale con oltre 13.000 dipendenti, siamo uno dei leader di mercato nel campo dei sistemi di rivestimento sottovuoto a film sottili ad alta tecnologia. Da oltre 150 anni offriamo ai nostri clienti una vasta gamma di sistemi per il rivestimento di lenti per occhiali, componenti ottici negli smartphone, automobili, tecnologia medicale, telecamere, display head-up e molto altro ancora.

Il nostro team internazionale riesce a stabilire nuovi standard ogni giorno e a realizzare con successo progetti complessi.

Allora il nostro programma di doppio grado Mechatronica in collaborazione con l'Università Tecnica di Aschaffenburg (TH AB) è proprio per voi!

Facciamo la differenza a Bühler! Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo ogni giorno che è stato prodotto sulle piante di Bühler. Sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità commerciali sostenibili nel settore alimentare, dei mangimi e della mobilità globale.

Vogliamo creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più rapido insieme.

Compiti:
• Viverete un pratico programma di doppio grado in cui la conoscenza universitaria e l'applicazione si completano perfettamente in azienda.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Bühler Leybold Optics stands for innovative technologies and steady growth. As part of the Bühler Group, a global engineering group with over 13,000 employees, we are one of the market leaders in the field of high-tech thin film vacuum coating systems. For more than 150 years, we have been offering our customers a wide range of systems for the coating of spectacle lenses, optical components in smartphones, cars, medical technology, cameras, head-up displays and much more.

Our international team manages to set new standards every day and successfully implement complex projects.

You are interested in the interface between mechanical engineering, electrical engineering and computer science? You want to take on real responsibility during your studies and participate in exciting projects?

Then our dual degree programme Mechatronics in cooperation with the Technical University of Aschaffenburg (TH AB) is just right for you!

Let's make a difference at Bühler! Two billion people eat food every day that was produced on Bühler plants. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced by Bühler technology. With every decision, Bühler aims to reconcile the needs of business, people and nature. We develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industry.

We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. That's why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

Tasks:
• You will experience a practical dual degree programme in which university knowledge and application complement each other perfectly in the company.

• In varied practical phases, you will work on specific tasks and projects and learn about several departments and interfaces.

• You will complete your studies in cooperation with TH Aschaffenburg.

• In addition, you will benefit from personal care, modernly equipped work environments and early preparation for the start of your career.

• After your completion, you will have a wide range of perspectives, e.g. in commissioning, PLC programming, production planning and project management.

Requirements:
• You have a high school degree, a university degree or a similar school qualification.

• Technical connections inspire you – especially topics from mathematics, physics and programming.

• You like to contribute practical skills and interest in manual and technical tasks with and with accomplices.

• You are distinguished by motivation, learning joy, team spirit and personal responsibility.

• A class B driver's license – depending on the field of application – a plus.

Your study model – TH AB dual:
• Degree: Bachelor of Engineering (B.Eng.)

• Duration: 6 semesters (regular study period, dual organized)

• Start: winter semester 2026

• Place Theory: Aschaffenburg University of Technology (hybrid concept: Presence + modern e-learning)

• Practical share: about 50% – already active in the company from the first semester

• Weekly model (during the lecture): 3 days theory at TH AB + 2 days practice in the company → lecture-free time = full practical application in the company

We offer: Family corporate culture We have a more than 160-year history. This makes us a company that thinks and invests in the long term - in innovation, our employees and economic success.

Professional and personal development We offer a wide range of learning opportunities, such as videos, online training, presence training and webinars with short, relevant, appealing, personalized and mobile formats.

A diverse and inclusive workplace We promote an inclusive culture that values our global diversity. Respect and empathy ensure that everyone feels safe and can do their best.

Family Corporate Culture We have a more than 160-year history. This makes us a company that thinks and invests in the long term - in innovations, our employees and economic success.

Modern workplace with the best technical equipment Work at a modern workplace equipped with the latest technical tools to promote your productivity and innovation.

Employee benefits and discounts Enjoy a variety of employee benefits and discounts that make your everyday life easier. Become part of our team and learn more.

We develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries. We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Bühler Leybold Optics est un des leaders du marché dans le domaine des systèmes de revêtement sous vide à film mince de haute technologie. Depuis plus de 150 ans, nous offrons à nos clients une large gamme de systèmes pour le revêtement des lentilles de spectacle, des composants optiques dans les smartphones, les voitures, la technologie médicale, les caméras, les écrans de tête et bien plus encore.

Notre équipe internationale parvient à établir de nouvelles normes chaque jour et à mettre en œuvre avec succès des projets complexes.

Vous êtes intéressé par l'interface entre l'ingénierie mécanique, l'ingénierie électrique et l'informatique? Vous voulez assumer une véritable responsabilité pendant vos études et participer à des projets passionnants?

Ensuite, notre programme de double diplôme Mechatronics en collaboration avec l'Université Technique d'Aschaffenburg (TH AB) est tout à fait parfait pour vous!

Deux milliards de personnes mangent chaque jour des aliments produits sur les usines de Bühler. Un milliard de personnes voyagent dans des véhicules dont les pièces ont été produites par la technologie Bühler. Avec chaque décision, Bühler vise à concilier les besoins des entreprises, des personnes et de la nature. Nous développons des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités commerciales durables dans l'industrie mondiale de l'alimentation, de l'alimentation animale et de la mobilité.

Nous voulons créer des innovations pour un monde meilleur, en mettant l'accent sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. C'est pourquoi nous travaillons avec nos clients, les start-up, les multinationales et les scientifiques pour obtenir un impact plus rapide ensemble.

Tâches:
• Vous vivrez un programme pratique de double diplôme dans lequel les connaissances universitaires et les applications se complètent parfaitement dans l'entreprise.

• Dans des phases pratiques variées, vous travaillerez sur des tâches et des projets spécifiques et vous en apprendrez davantage sur plusieurs départements et interfaces.

• Vous terminerez vos études en collaboration avec TH Aschaffenburg.

• En outre, vous bénéficierez de soins personnels, d'environnements de travail modernes et de la préparation précoce au début de votre carrière.

• Une fois votre projet terminé, vous aurez une large gamme de perspectives, par exemple en mise en service, programmation PLC, planification de la production et gestion de projet.

Exigences:
• Vous avez un diplôme d'études secondaires, un diplôme universitaire ou une qualification scolaire similaire.

• Les connexions techniques vous inspirent – particulièrement les sujets des mathématiques, de la physique et de la programmation.

• Vous aimez contribuer aux compétences pratiques et à l'intérêt pour les tâches manuelles et techniques avec et avec les complices.

• Vous vous distinguez par la motivation, la joie d'apprendre, l'esprit d'équipe et la responsabilité personnelle.

• Un permis de conduire de classe B – selon le champ d'application – un plus.

Votre modèle d'étude – TH AB dual:
• Diplôme: Baccalauréat en génie (B.Eng.)

Bühler Leybold Optics stands for innovative technologies and steady growth. As part of the Bühler Group, a global engineering group with over 13,000 employees, we are the market leader in the field of high-tech thin film vacuum coating systems. Then our dual degree programme in cooperation with the Technical University of Aschaffenburg (TH AB) is just the right thing!

Let's make a difference at Bühler! Two billion people eat food every day that was produced on Bühler plants. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced by Bühler technology. With every decision, Bühler aims to reconcile the needs of business, people and nature. We develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industry.

We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. That's why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

• After your completion, you will have a wide range of perspectives, e.g. in electrical design, PLC programming, software development and commissioning.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Come Specialista di Gestione Cash & FX, unirai il nostro team Corporate Treasury e contribuirà a un ambiente altamente internazionale e dinamico. Con sede a Uzwil, sosterrai la nostra organizzazione globale in più di 80 paesi con servizi bancari attraverso la gestione di cassa e liquidità, transazioni di pagamento, gestione del rischio di cambio e investimenti. Agendo come un collegamento chiave tra i nostri stakeholder interni e i nostri partner bancari, aiuterai a garantire operazioni di Tesoro efficienti, sicure e trasparenti in tutto il Gruppo. • Esperienza in Treasury Accounting o Banking con forti competenze Excel, solide capacità di analisi dei dati e conoscenza di SAP
• Punti di forza tecnici e analitici tra cui la comprensione rapida, la comprensione del sistema e la capacità di automatizzare i flussi di lavoro
• Stile di lavoro indipendente e collaborativo caratterizzato da professionalità, interazione amichevole e lavoro di squadra efficace

descriptionByLocale.en:
As a Cash & FX Management Specialist, you will join our Corporate Treasury team and contribute to a highly international and dynamic environment. Based at our headquarters in Uzwil, you will support our global organization in more than 80 countries with banking services across cash and liquidity management, payment transactions, foreign exchange risk management and investments. Acting as a key link between our internal stakeholders and our banking partners, you will help ensure efficient, secure and transparent Treasury operations across the Group.

Aufgaben:
• You support daily Treasury operations, including cash management, FX activities, and periodic FX and interest rate fixings

• You manage intercompany processes such as monthly netting cycles, internal FX hedging, and cash pool administration with interest calculations

• You ensure accurate FX accounting by handling month-end valuation, hedge accounting, and financial result reporting

• You oversee treasury-related accounting tasks in collaboration with global teams and liaise with banks and internal stakeholders on payment matters

• You administer and enhance Treasury systems, support bank connectivity (EBICS/SWIFT), and contribute to automation and process improvement projects

Anforderungen:
• Degree in a relevant field such as Finance, Business Administration, Economics or a comparable discipline

• Experience in Treasury Accounting or Banking with strong Excel skills, solid data analysis capabilities and knowledge of SAP

• Technical and analytical strengths including quick comprehension, system understanding and the ability to automate workflows

• Independent and collaborative working style marked by professionalism, friendly interaction and effective teamwork

• Fluency in English and German

Wir bieten:
Attractive vacation entitlement
Enough time for relaxation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of vacation per year depending on age.

Attractive mobility concept
We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + half-fare travelcard for CHF 365 + CHF 400 public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class travelcard or free parking.

VIVA Restaurant
We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9, 00 CHF.

Employer-funded pension plan
The Bühler Pension Fund offers Bühler employees an independent pension fund that ensures reliable financial security in retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch

Sports activities
We promote physical activity through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for Update and Activ Fitness.

Health-Port
We are committed to preventive health care through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Vous soutenez l'équipe de leadership des grains et des aliments dans un rôle d'assistant central et responsable et vous assurez un processus en douceur avec le talent organisationnel, la proactivité et l'orientation du service. Que ce soit les visites des clients, les événements, la planification des voyages internationaux ou l'entretien d'importantes plates-formes d'affaires – vous maintenez les chaînes ensemble, alléger le fardeau de l'équipe de leadership Grains & Food et assumer la responsabilité globale dans votre secteur.

Tâches :
• Vous soutenez l'équipe de leadership des grains et des aliments dans les activités opérationnelles et administratives quotidiennes et vous assurez un processus en douceur

• Vous organisez des événements clients, des visites, des événements et des événements professionnels, tournés vers l'avenir et axés sur le service

• Vous planifiez et coordonnez les voyages pour le PDG et l'équipe Grains & Food Office – y compris les réservations, les hôtels, les visas et la coordination des agences de voyage

• Vous maintenez et mettez à jour les pages d'affaires et de réunions sur l'intranet et vous assurez une base d'information fiable

• Vous assumez la responsabilité globale dans votre domaine de responsabilité, représentez au sein de l'équipe d'assistance et participez activement à d'autres sujets et projets dans le secteur des céréales et de l'alimentation

Exigences
• Formation commerciale ou équivalente, idéalement complétée par une formation complémentaire dans le domaine de l'assistance, de l'administration ou de l'organisation des entreprises

• Plusieurs années d'expérience professionnelle dans une fonction comparable, de préférence dans une entreprise ou un environnement international

• Forte force organisationnelle et méthodologique, méthodes de travail proactives et indépendantes et personnalité résiliente, orientée vers le service et forte communication

• Très bonne connaissance des produits Office, en particulier les équipes Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook et MS, ainsi que l'utilisation courante des outils numériques

• Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais en paroles et en écriture

Nous offrons:
Droit aux congés annuels attractifs
Temps suffisant pour les loisirs et les intérêts personnels - nous offrons de 25 à 30 jours de vacances par an selon l'année de la vie.

Concept de mobilité attractive
Nous offrons un OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + demi-taxe pour 365 CHF + 400CHF crédit de transport en commun ainsi qu'un abonnement de première classe attrayant ou un parking gratuit.

Restaurant du personnel VIVA
Nous offrons à nos employés un menu de fitness quotidien à partir de 9.00 CHF.

Régime de retraite financé par l'employeur
Bühler Pensionskasse offre à ses salariés une caisse de retraite indépendante qui assure une retraite financière fiable: www.pk-buhler.ch

Activités sportives
Nous promouvons le sport par l'entraînement en circuit auto-organisé et des groupes de course ainsi que des bons de mise à jour et de fitness actif.

Port sanitaire
Nous sommes engagés dans la prévention de la santé par des analyses de laboratoire, des massages, des conseils nutritionnels, la physiothérapie, des cours de groupe et un médecin d'entreprise.

Deux milliards de personnes mangent chaque jour des aliments produits dans les usines de Bühler. Un milliard de personnes voyagent dans des véhicules dont les pièces ont été produites grâce aux technologies Bühler.
Avec chaque décision, Bühler poursuit l'objectif de concilier les besoins de l'économie, des personnes et de la nature. De cette manière, nous développons des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités commerciales durables dans les industries mondiales des aliments pour animaux, des aliments pour animaux et de la mobilité.
Nous voulons innover pour un monde meilleur, avec un accent particulier sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. C'est pourquoi nous travaillons avec les clients, les start-up, les multinationales et les scientifiques pour obtenir un impact plus rapide ensemble.

titleByLocale.it: Gestione delle vendite internazionale Nuts Processing
titleByLocale.fr: Directeur des ventes internationales Traitement des noix

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei appassionato di mercati in crescita, sviluppo di persone, e il successo di vendite leader in un ambiente dinamico internazionale? Come International Sales Manager Nuts Processing, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nella guida della crescita redditizia da leader e coaching Customer Relationship Manager, espandendo le relazioni con i clienti e sviluppando nuove opportunità di business. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con team di vendita regionali, clienti e stakeholder interni per garantire un'eccellente esecuzione commerciale e una crescita sostenibile del business nel segmento Nuts Processing.

Aufgaben:
• Condurre, allenare e sviluppare Customer Relationship Manager per raggiungere obiettivi di crescita ambiziosi e rafforzare le capacità di vendita

• Gestisci e cresci relazioni strategiche con i clienti, supportando complesse opportunità di vendita, trattative e sviluppo di soluzioni

• Identifichi nuove opportunità di business, segmenti dei clienti e tendenze di mercato per guidare la crescita sostenibile e fornire l'intelligenza di mercato attuabile

• Collaborate con il responsabile del segmento di mercato, la leadership di vendite Chocolate & Flavor Creation e gli stakeholder interni per sviluppare ed eseguire strategie di vendita

• Garantisci l'eccellenza delle vendite attraverso un'efficace collaborazione interfunzionale, abilitazione tecnica del team di vendita e dati CRM di alta qualità e reporting

Anforderungen:
• Risultato successo nelle vendite di B2B tecnici, nella gestione del conto o nello sviluppo di business all'interno di attrezzature di capitale, tecnologia di processo, lavorazione del cibo o industrie correlate

• Esperienza in un ruolo commerciale rivolto al cliente, come Sales Manager, Senior Customer Relationship Manager o Key Account Manager

• Il know-how tecnico nelle tecnologie di trasformazione e lavorazione industriale, con la capacità di supportare i clienti in complesse discussioni commerciali e tecniche

• Mindset strategico e imprenditoriale combinato con forte acume commerciale e l'esperienza di gestione complessi cicli di vendita e negoziazione

• Ottima comunicazione, gestione delle parti interessate e capacità organizzative, con fluenza in inglese; lingue aggiuntive (tedesco, spagnolo) sono un vantaggio

Wir bieten:
Attraente diritto di vacanza
Abbastanza tempo per il relax e gli interessi personali - offriamo da 25 a 30 giorni di vacanza all'anno a seconda dell'età.

Concetto di mobilità attraente
Offriamo una OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + mezza carta di viaggio per CHF 365 + CHF 400 credito di trasporto pubblico, nonché una attraente carta di viaggio di prima classe o un parcheggio gratuito.

Ristorante VIVA
Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti un menu di fitness giornaliero da 9, 00 CHF.

Piano pensionistico finanziato dal datore di lavoro
Il Bühler Pension Fund offre ai dipendenti Bühler un fondo pensione indipendente che garantisce una sicurezza finanziaria affidabile in pensione: www.pk-buhler.ch

Attività sportive
Promuoviamo l'attività fisica attraverso la formazione di circuiti auto-organizzati e gruppi in esecuzione, nonché buoni per l'aggiornamento e l'attivazione di fitness.

Salute-Porto
Ci impegniamo per l'assistenza sanitaria preventiva attraverso analisi di laboratorio, massaggi, consulenza nutrizionale, fisioterapia, corsi di gruppo e un medico aziendale.

Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo ogni giorno che è stato prodotto con attrezzature Bühler. Un miliardo di persone guidano veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte con le nostre macchine.
Bühler si propone di bilanciare l'umanità, la natura e l'economia in ogni decisione, sviluppando soluzioni che sbloccano opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale.
Ci sforziamo di creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con un focus speciale su soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Pertanto, ci impegniamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e accademia per accelerare l'impatto insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you passionate about growing markets, developing people, and leading sales success in a dynamic international environment? As International Sales Manager Nuts Processing, you will play a key role in driving profitable growth by leading and coaching Customer Relationship Managers, expanding customer relationships, and developing new business opportunities. You will work closely with regional sales teams, customers, and internal stakeholders to ensure excellent commercial execution and sustainable business growth in the Nuts Processing segment.

Aufgaben:
• You lead, coach, and develop Customer Relationship Managers to achieve ambitious growth targets and strengthen sales capabilities

• You manage and grow strategic customer relationships while supporting complex sales opportunities, negotiations, and solution development

• You identify new business opportunities, customer segments, and market trends to drive sustainable growth and provide actionable market intelligence

• You collaborate with the Head of Market Segment Nuts, Chocolate & Flavor Creation sales leadership, and internal stakeholders to develop and execute sales strategies

• You ensure sales excellence through effective cross-functional collaboration, technical enablement of the sales team, and high-quality CRM data and reporting

Anforderungen:
• Proven success in technical B2B sales, account management, or business development within capital equipment, process technology, food processing, or related industries

• Experience in a customer-facing commercial role, such as Sales Manager, Senior Customer Relationship Manager or Key Account Manager

• Technical know-how in food processing and industrial processing technologies, with the ability to support customers in complex commercial and technical discussions

• Strategic and entrepreneurial mindset combined with strong commercial acumen and experience managing complex sales cycles and negotiation

• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and organizational skills, with fluency in English; additional languages (German, Spanish) are an advantage

Wir bieten:
Attractive vacation entitlement
Enough time for relaxation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of vacation per year depending on age.

Attractive mobility concept
We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + half-fare travelcard for CHF 365 + CHF 400 public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class travelcard or free parking.

VIVA Restaurant
We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9, 00 CHF.

Employer-funded pension plan
The Bühler Pension Fund offers Bühler employees an independent pension fund that ensures reliable financial security in retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch

Sports activities
We promote physical activity through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for Update and Activ Fitness.

Health-Port
We are committed to preventive health care through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Haben Sie eine Leidenschaft für wachsende Märkte, sich entwickelnde Menschen und führenden Verkaufserfolg in einem dynamischen internationalen Umfeld? Als International Sales Manager Nuts Processing spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Förderung profitablen Wachstums, indem Sie Customer Relationship Manager leiten und coachen, Kundenbeziehungen ausbauen und neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten entwickeln. Sie arbeiten eng mit regionalen Vertriebsteams, Kunden und internen Stakeholdern zusammen, um eine hervorragende kommerzielle Umsetzung und ein nachhaltiges Geschäftswachstum im Segment Nuts Processing sicherzustellen.

Aufgaben:
• Sie führen, coachen und entwickeln Customer Relationship Manager, um ehrgeizige Wachstumsziele zu erreichen und die Vertriebskapazität zu stärken

• Sie verwalten und erweitern strategische Kundenbeziehungen und unterstützen gleichzeitig komplexe Verkaufschancen, Verhandlungen und Lösungsentwicklung

• Sie identifizieren neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten, Kundensegmente und Markttrends, um nachhaltiges Wachstum voranzutreiben und umsetzbare Marktinformationen zu liefern

• Sie arbeiten mit dem Head of Market Segment Nuts, Chocolate & Flavor Creation Sales Leadership und internen Stakeholdern zusammen, um Vertriebsstrategien zu entwickeln und umzusetzen

• Sie sichern Vertriebsexzellenz durch effektive funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit, technische Aktivierung des Vertriebsteams und hochwertige CRM-Daten und Reporting

Anforderungen:
• Nachgewiesener Erfolg im technischen B2B-Vertrieb, Account Management oder Geschäftsentwicklung in den Bereichen Investitionsgüter, Prozesstechnologie, Lebensmittelverarbeitung oder verwandte Branchen

• Erfahrung in einer kundenorientierten kommerziellen Rolle wie Sales Manager, Senior Customer Relationship Manager oder Key Account Manager

• Technisches Know-how in der Lebensmittelverarbeitung und industriellen Verarbeitungstechnologien, mit der Fähigkeit, Kunden in komplexen kommerziellen und technischen Diskussionen zu unterstützen

• Strategische und unternehmerische Denkweise kombiniert mit starkem Geschäftssinn und Erfahrung beim Management komplexer Verkaufszyklen und Verhandlungen

• Ausgezeichnete Kommunikation, Stakeholder-Management und organisatorische Fähigkeiten, mit fließend Englisch; zusätzliche Sprachen (Deutsch, Spanisch) sind von Vorteil

Wir bieten:
Attraktive Urlaubsberechtigung
Genug Zeit für Entspannung und persönliche Interessen - wir bieten von 25 bis 30 Tagen Urlaub pro Jahr je nach Alter.

Attraktives Mobilitätskonzept
Wir bieten eine OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Halbtax-Fahrkarte für CHF 365 + CHF 400 öffentlicher Nahverkehr sowie eine attraktive First-Class-Fahrkarte oder kostenlose Parkplätze an.

VIVA Restaurant
Wir bieten unseren Mitarbeitern ein tägliches Fitnessmenü ab 9.00 CHF.

Arbeitgebergedeckte Altersvorsorge
Die Bühler Pensionskasse bietet Bühler Mitarbeitern eine unabhängige Pensionskasse, die eine zuverlässige finanzielle Absicherung im Ruhestand gewährleistet: www.pk-buhler.ch

Sportarten
Wir fördern körperliche Aktivität durch selbstorganisiertes Zirkeltraining und Laufgruppen sowie Gutscheine für Update und Activ Fitness.

Gesundheitshafen
Wir engagieren uns für die präventive Gesundheitsversorgung durch Laboranalysen, Massagen, Ernährungsberatung, Physiotherapie, Gruppenkurse und einen Betriebsarzt.

Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die mit Bühler-Geräten hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen fahren Fahrzeuge, deren Teile mit unseren Maschinen hergestellt wurden.
Bühler zielt darauf ab, Mensch, Natur und Wirtschaft bei jeder Entscheidung in Einklang zu bringen, indem es Lösungen entwickelt, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsbranche erschließen.
Wir bemühen uns, Innovationen für eine bessere Welt zu schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Daher arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Unternehmen und der akademischen Welt zusammen, um die Wirkung gemeinsam zu beschleunigen.

Bühler Leybold Optics è sinonimo di tecnologie innovative e crescita costante. Come parte del Gruppo Bühler, un gruppo di ingegneria globale con oltre 13.000 dipendenti, siamo uno dei leader di mercato nel campo dei sistemi di rivestimento sottovuoto a film sottili ad alta tecnologia. Da oltre 150 anni offriamo ai nostri clienti un'ampia gamma di sistemi per il rivestimento di vetro architettonico, lenti, componenti ottici in smartphone, auto, tecnologia medicale e molto altro ancora.

Il nostro team internazionale riesce a stabilire nuovi standard ogni giorno e a realizzare con successo progetti complessi.

Per rafforzare il nostro team, ti cerchiamo come montatore (m/p/d). In questo ruolo, assembla assemblaggi con alta precisione e dare un contributo decisivo per dare vita a tecnologie innovative. Entra a far parte del nostro team dedicato a Bühler Alzenau GmbH a Hasselroth e porta la tua maestria artigianale dove la tecnologia sta plasmando il futuro.

A Bühler facciamo la differenza: ogni giorno due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo prodotto sulle piante di Bühler; un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte dalla tecnologia di Bühler. Vogliamo creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più rapido insieme.

Bühler Leybold Optics stands for innovative technologies and steady growth. As part of the Bühler Group, a global engineering group with over 13,000 employees, we are one of the market leaders in the field of high-tech thin film vacuum coating systems. For more than 150 years, we have been offering our customers a wide range of systems for the coating of architectural glass, lens lenses, optical components in smartphones, cars, medical technology and much more.

Our international team manages to set new standards every day and successfully implement complex projects.

To strengthen our team, we are looking for you as a fitter (m/w/d). In this role, you assemble assemblies with high precision and make a decisive contribution to bringing innovative technologies to life. Become part of our dedicated team at Bühler Alzenau GmbH in Hasselroth and bring your craftsmanship to where technology is shaping the future.

Let us make a difference at Bühler! Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts have been produced by Bühler technology. With every decision, Bühler aims to reconcile the needs of business, people and nature, and to develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.

We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. That's why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

Tasks:
• They assemble mechanical assemblies and complete systems according to drawing and specification.

• You carefully check components and document your results in test protocols.

• You keep an eye on the dates and progress of your assigned assemblies.

• You work on repair orders reliably and solution-oriented.

• With your precise work, you make an important contribution to the quality of our high-tech systems.

Requirements:
• You have successfully completed a technical training, e.g. as an industrial mechanic, mechatronics engineer or in a comparable profession.

• Ideally, you will bring your first experience in assembly of assemblies, components or systems.

• You work carefully, accurately and with a high quality.

• They bring technical understanding and pleasure in mechanical assembly.

• You like to work in a team and take responsibility for your tasks.

We offer: Public and private connections Our location offers excellent connections to public transport and convenient parking spaces that make it easier for you to commute daily.

Family Corporate Culture We have a more than 160-year history. This makes us a company that thinks and invests in the long term - in innovations, our employees and economic success.

Team events and events Your commitment makes it possible for us. We want to celebrate this together with you. Our Christmas parties, summer parties, sports events and team events offer the best opportunities.

Intercultural working environment The key to our success is our diverse workforce from more than 100 nations and our inclusive culture.

Employee benefits and discounts Enjoy a variety of employee benefits and discounts that make your everyday life easier. Become part of our team and learn more.

Open communication culture Benefit from an open communication culture that promotes transparency and exchange!

Beschreibung Täglich essen zwei Milliarden Menschen Lebensmittel, die mit Bühler-Geräten hergestellt wurden.
