les entreprises sont un plus

Description Deux milliards de personnes mangent chaque jour des aliments produits avec des équipements Bühler. Un milliard de personnes conduisent des véhicules dont les pièces ont été fabriquées avec nos machines. Bühler vise à équilibrer l'humanité, la nature et l'économie dans chaque décision, en développant des solutions qui permettent de libérer des opportunités d'affaires durables dans les industries mondiales de l'alimentation, de l'alimentation et de la mobilité.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Aufgaben - Guida e gestisce i responsabili delle quotazioni per il Sud-Est asiatico, garantendo alte prestazioni e impegno. - Sorveglia il processo di quotazione del cliente end-to-end per contribuire al fatturato delle vendite. - Monitora il carico di lavoro del team e alloca risorse in modo efficace per soddisfare il fatturato degli ordini. - Gestisci le richieste dei clienti in arrivo professionalmente, garantendo una risoluzione rapida e approfondita dei problemi. - Costruisci la competenza di livello 1 nell'identificazione dei pezzi di ricambio per le BU assegnate, supportate da consulenti tecnici di 2° livello e BA/BU (Global/Region) durante il processo di quotazione.

- Guidare i miglioramenti dei processi e implementare le migliori pratiche per l'efficienza e l'accuratezza. - Gestire le escalation e risolvere problemi complessi dei clienti. - Collaborare con team cross-funzionali per garantire operazioni senza soluzione di continuità. - Sviluppare capacità del team attraverso valutazioni di coaching, formazione e prestazioni. - Eseguire ulteriori compiti e responsabilità man mano che le esigenze aziendali si evolvono.

Anforderungen - Minimo 5 anni di esperienza in ambito di quotazione tecnica; con 3 anni di ruolo di supervisione o di guida in team. - Esperienza di Proven nella gestione di team e nella guida di eccellenza operativa. - Meccanica, Elettronica & Elettronica, Ingegneria Meccatronica o formazione simile. - Macchinari di base di conoscenza e familiarità con MRO. - Savvy IT, esperto in MS Office, con conoscenza operativa delle piattaforme SAP/ CRM (ad esempio Salesforce SAP (modulo SD, Stock, Acquisti).

Descrizione Ogni giorno due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo prodotto con le attrezzature Bühler. Un miliardo di persone guidano veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte con le nostre macchine. Bühler punta a bilanciare l'umanità, la natura e l'economia in ogni decisione, sviluppando soluzioni che sblocchino opportunità di business sostenibili nell'industria alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. Ci sforziamo di creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con una particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Pertanto, collaboriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e mondo accademico per accelerare l'impatto insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Aufgaben:
• Lead and manage the Quotation officers for Southeast Asia, ensuring high performance and engagement.

• Oversee the customer end-to-end quotation process in contributing to sales turnover.

• Monitor team workload and allocate resources effectively to meet the order revenue and turnover of orders.

• Handle incoming customer requests professionally, ensuring prompt and thorough resolution of issues.

• Build Level 1 competency in spare parts identification for assigned BUs, supported by 2nd-level Technical Advisors and BA/BU (Global/Region) teams during the quotation process.

• Drive process improvements and implement best practices for efficiency and accuracy.

• Handle escalations and resolve complex customer issues.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless operations.

• Develop team capabilities through coaching, training and performance reviews.

• Perform additional duties and responsibilities as business needs evolve.

Anforderungen:
• Minimum 5 years experience in technical quotation environment; with 3 years in a supervisory or team lead role.

• Proven experience in managing teams and driving operational excellence.

• Mechanical, Electrical & Electronics, Mechatronics Engineering or similar education background.

• Basic knowledge machinery and familiar with MRO.

• IT savvy, proficient in MS Office, with working knowledge of SAP/ CRM platforms (e.g. Salesforce SAP (SD Module, Stock, Purchasing).

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.

Unisciti a Bühler come Intern in Market Development – Grains & Food e contribuisci a un compito strategico incentrato sulla definizione di future opportunità di crescita. In questo ruolo, esplorerai paesaggi di mercato emergenti, analizzerai catene di valore e dinamiche di mercato, e identificherai opportunità di business ad alto potenziale all'incrocio tra sistemi alimentari, innovazione e tecnologia. Il ruolo è posizionato all'interno dell'Ufficio CEO di Grains & Food a livello divisionale e riporta direttamente alla Responsabile Strategia. Offre un'esposizione eccezionale ai decisori senior, con una stretta collaborazione tra la leadership di Business Area e la gestione a livello C. Questo tirocinio di 12 mesi offre un'opportunità unica per lavorare in modo indipendente in un ambiente esplorativo e dare un contributo significativo alla direzione futura dell'azienda.

Aufgaben:
• Esplorare e strutturare nuove aree di crescita analizzando catene di valore, dinamiche di mercato e driver chiave del settore.

• Identificare applicazioni ad alto potenziale e opportunità di business combinando intuizioni di mercato con prospettive tecnologiche.

• I punti di forza e le capacità interne di Bühler nelle aree aziendali per scoprire sinergie, lacune e punti di leva.

• Sviluppa raccomandazioni strategiche basate sui fatti e approfondimenti pronti a decidere per sostenere le future decisioni aziendali.

• Priorizzare gli spazi opportunità basati sull'attrattiva del mercato, sulla vestibilità strategica e sul potenziale valore di Bühler.

Anforderungen:
• Sei uno studente di Master o recentemente laureato in Business e Strategia, Business Innovation, International Management, o un campo correlato.

• Porti una vera curiosità per l'innovazione, i sistemi alimentari e le tecnologie future.

• Pensi in modo strutturato e puoi tradurre argomenti complessi in chiare intuizioni.

• Siete comodi a lavorare in modo indipendente in un ambiente ambiguo ed esplorativo con struttura predefinita limitata.

• Si comunica con fiducia ed efficacia sia con esperti tecnici che con gli stakeholder aziendali.

Join Bühler as an Intern in Market Development – Grains & Food and contribute to a strategic assignment focused on shaping future growth opportunities. In this role, you will explore emerging market landscapes, analyze value chains and market dynamics, and identify high-potential business opportunities at the intersection of food systems, innovation, and technology. The role is positioned within the Grains & Food CEO Office at divisional level and reports directly to the Strategy Responsible. It offers exceptional exposure to senior decision-makers, with close collaboration across Business Area leadership and C-level management. This 12 months internship offers a unique opportunity to work independently in an exploratory environment and make a meaningful contribution to the company's future direction.

Aufgaben:
• Explore and structure new growth areas by analyzing value chains, market dynamics, and key industry drivers.

• Identify high-potential applications and business opportunities by combining market insights with technology perspectives.

• Map Bühler's internal strengths and capabilities across business areas to uncover synergies, gaps, and leverage points.

• Develop fact-based strategic recommendations and decision-ready insights to support future business decisions.

• Prioritize opportunity spaces based on market attractiveness, strategic fit, and potential value for Bühler.

Anforderungen:
• You are a Master's student or recent graduate in Business and Strategy, Business Innovation, International Management, or a related field.

• You bring genuine curiosity for innovation, food systems, and future technologies.

• You think in a structured way and can translate complex topics into clear insights.

• You are comfortable working independently in an ambiguous, exploratory environment with limited predefined structure.

• You communicate confidently and effectively with both technical experts and business stakeholders.

In this role you will lead and support a regional team of field service professionals who install, maintain, and troubleshoot customer equipment. Your focus is on helping your team work safely, deliver high‑quality results, and create a great experience for customers from start to finish.
You'll set clear expectations, coach team members, and ensure service work is completed efficiently and profitably. You'll partner closely with customers to understand their needs, resolve issues quickly, and ensure every project meets company quality and safety standards. Ultimately, you are responsible for the success of all field service activities within your assigned business area, while building a skilled, motivated, and customer‑focused team. Aufgaben: • Recruit, onboard, develop, and performance-manage Field Service Engineers (FSEs) using clear goals, IDPs, the Skills Matrix, and SuccessFactors/EPM+. • Upskill FSEs in mechanical/electronic competencies, market needs, documentation quality, customer communication, and professional reporting; conduct post‑job reviews. • Foster a safety‑first, continuous improvement culture aligned with Bühler values, enforcing all EHS/OSHA/LOTO standards and ensuring timely training and incident reporting. • Maintain deep technical curiosity and build strong working knowledge of the Bühler product portfolio, equipment, and processes. • Plan, assign, and optimize field resources to meet customer timelines, commissioning milestones, repairs, overhauls, and preventive maintenance schedules. • Review job scopes, confirm tool/parts readiness, and monitor job progress while managing escalations and complex troubleshooting with BU, Engineering, Quality, and Remote Support. • Ensure timely, professional communication with all internal and external stakeholders, taking full ownership of customer requests and escalations through closure. • Coordinate service support for project managers and ensure proper costing, accurate quotations, and timely approval of timesheets/expenses. • Manage team utilization, schedule adherence, warranty cost control, and travel/expense discipline aligned with financial goals. • Drive first‑time‑fix rates, job quality, KPI achievement, and identification of service sales opportunities (upgrades, PM contracts, training, parts). • Leverage SAP, SuccessFactors, CAQ, CRM, and reporting tools to guide decisions, recommend improvements, and support SQCDP/continuous improvement efforts. Anforderungen: • 5+ years in people leadership or technical lead capacity is required. • 5+ years in industrial field service (installation, commissioning, troubleshooting) is preferred. • Strong mechanical and industrial knowledge. • Demonstrated customer facing communication skills and conflict resolution. • Prior leadership/management role. • Formal leadership training. • Microsoft Office is required. • SAP experience is preferred. • Experience with food processing equipment (e.g., pasta, grain, milling, mixing, conveying, thermal, or sorting systems) is preferred. • Ownership & Judgment: Prioritizes safety and quality; makes data backed decisions under time pressure. • Coaching Mindset: Develops talent through feedback, on the job training, and structured learning paths. • Customer Centricity: Anticipates needs; communicates proactively; manages expectations. • Collaboration: Works across Product Lines, Engineering, Quality, and Sales to solve problems. • Continuous Improvement: Challenges the status quo; standardizes and shares best practices. Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

descriptionByLocale.en:
With over 160 years of experience, Bühler Leybold Optics is a leading supplier of thin-film vacuum coating technology. Our state-of-the art solutions include semiconductor, precision or ophthalmic optics applications, the metalization of headlights for the automotive industry, architectural and automotive glass, roll-to-roll substrates for capacitors or flexible electronics.

As a Sales Account Manager, you'll play a key role in helping customers find the right precision optics and optoelectronic vacuum coating solutions for their needs. You'll work closely with clients to understand their challenges and guide them toward new and used equipment, upgrades, retrofits, and complete process solutions that support their goals. In this role, you'll have the opportunity to build lasting relationships, shape the customer experience, and help bring innovative technology to market through effective sales strategy and product promotion. Aufgaben: • Working closely with potential customers to define detailed system specifications, with recommendations of technology, processes, and hardware to best meet their needs. • Prepare and issue detailed quotations for customers. • Identification of new technology areas and applications for Leybold Optics products. • Development of new accounts in the North American market (USA and Canada). • Account management of existing accounts in the North American market. • Working with project management to define machine layout, technical specifications, and installations. • Coordinating with customer support, service support, and finance to resolve issues with accounts such as order processing issues, payment issues, and technical issues related to products. • Define, develop, and implement marketing strategies in accordance with annual budget. • Coordinating and helping to organize trade shows and exhibitions. • Coordinating and helping to organize any technical symposiums. • Attending any necessary trade or technology seminars and organizations. • Supporting the advertising and marketing program by writing articles, advertorials, press releases or other forms of advertising. • Attending any internal sales meetings, product launch functions, or other sales related activities within the sales region or internationally. • Must arrive to work predictably and promptly. • Performs other duties as assigned. Anforderungen: • Bachelor's degree in physics or a related field. • 6-8 years of experience in field of optical and optoelectronics vacuum coatings or relevant technologies. • Previous sales experience is required, preferably in capital equipment sales. • Strong Microsoft Office skills. • Strong customer relationship, sales and negotiating skills. • Sufficient technical knowledge of products to be sold. • Ability to work with minimal supervision and make decisions independently, effectively, and creatively within established company guidelines. • Understands confidential nature of organizational and employee information and observes confidentiality. • Works as a proactive team player with an ownership approach to work. • Ability to identify, evaluate, problem solve, and give direction regarding problem resolutions for individual and company issues, at strategic and functional level. • Speaks and understands English. • German/Spanish language skills a plus. • Domestic and international travel 50% time which may include long hours and non-traditional work schedules. Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

• Idealmente, diversi anni di esperienza pratica nell'automazione

• Esperienza nella gestione del software di controllo e visualizzazione PLC (Siemens Passo 7 Tia Portal)

• Buona conoscenza lingue tedesco e inglese

• Affidabilità, capacità di carico e capacità del team

• Volontà di partecipare al nostro servizio clienti 24/7

• Gestione sicura del tempo, metodi di lavoro flessibili e indipendenti

• Ottime capacità comunicative, alto orientamento clienti e servizi

• pronto a viaggiare (circa 15-20) nel contesto delle operazioni di messa in servizio e di servizio

2007年，布勒（无锡）商业有限公司成立于江苏无锡市。凭借先进的技术优势，公司在谷物处理加工、消费食品制造及研磨与分散等领域引领市场。公司拥有制粉，面条，色选，消费食品，研磨分散等多个独立应用中心及客户服务中心，提供多产业链集成解决方案。我们秉持“布勒创新，驱动未来”愿景 ，携布勒集团全球资源，利用本地化优势，致力于开发更多创新解决方案。

Aufgaben:
• 根据布勒统一的流程负责产品研发及产品生命周期管理。从事以下一种或多种任务：

• 或独立负责一套新系统（由若干单元设备组成，包括前期市场调研、方案制定与设计、样机测试及后续的设备市场推广）的独立开发；

• 或协助整机设备开发项目，进行部件或者零件的设计；

• 或对现有老设备进行升级改进；

• 或负责国外技术转让设备项目（图纸国产化、设备制造跟踪等）；

• 或负责客户需求技术对接；

• 产品工程师将涉及到以下工作职责：

• 根据产品开发任务书，确定概念设计方案；

• 和制造工艺技术人员一起制订可制造性/成本合理的零部件结构；

• 对新开发零部件协助供应链部门和外协供应商或者外购供应商进行技术沟通，首样验收确认等；

• 跟踪所负责的设备或者零部件的制造及质量控制，发现问题并改进；

• 在公司内部新设备测试中心对样机进行带料测试，或者客户现场带料测试，发现问题并改进；

• 跟踪新产品市场推广，根据使用情况及客户反馈，发现问题并改进；

• 支持其他团队，对销售项目提供技术支持；

Anforderungen:
• 大学本科或研究生学历， 机械设计制造及自动化专业和机械设计相关专业；

• 从事机械设计相关工作3年以上，有分散研磨设备设计经验更佳；

• 具备良好的机械设计专业素质，以及创新精神；

• 具备3D CAD设计软件（Inventor，Solidworks等）经验；

• 具备良好的英语读写能力及口语沟通能力

• 具备团队精神,开诚布公,良好的人际沟通能力

descriptionByLocale.it:
Bühler Leybold Optics steht für innovative Technologien und stetiges Wachstum. Als Teil der Bühler Group, einem weltweit agierenden Maschinenbaukonzern mit über 13.000 Mitarbeitenden, sind wir einer der Marktführer im Bereich Hightech-Dünnfilm-Vakuumbeschichtungsanlagen. Seit mehr als 150 Jahren bieten wir unseren Kunden ein breites Angebot an Anlagen für die Beschichtung von Brillengläsern, optischen Komponenten in Smartphones, Autos, Medizintechnik Kameras, Head Up Displays von Autos und vielem mehr. Unserem internationalen Team gelingt es tagtäglich neue Maßstäbe zu setzen und komplexe Projekte erfolgreich umzusetzen.
Wir suchen einen motivierten Werkstudenten (m/w/d), der unser Team der kaufmännischen Auftragsabwicklung in Alzenau tatkräftig unterstützt. Unser Wunschkollege (m/w/d) besticht durch Genauigkeit und Zuverlässigkeit und scheut sich nicht davor eigenständig Aufgaben zu übernehmen.

Lassen Sie uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen. Aufgaben: • Du unterstützt im Tagesgeschäft, u.a. bei der Erstellung von Versandpapieren, der Anlage und Betreuung von Projekten in SAP • Du betreust eigenverantwortlich Aufgabenstellungen im Rahmen der Auftragsabwicklung mit weltweitem Bezug • Du unterstützt beim Zahlungsmanagement für Leistungen externer Vertriebspartner • Du erstellst Auswertungen mit Hilfe von SAP • Du unterstützt in laufenden internen Projekten (z.B. in Bezug auf Prozessverbesserungen) Anforderungen: • Du bist immatrikulierter Student (m/w/d) in einem wirtschaftlichen Studiengang • Du hast einen sicheren Umgang mit Microsoft Office und idealerweise erste Erfahrungen mit SAP • Du hast gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift • Eine selbstständige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise vervollständigt dein Profil Wir bieten: Kantine mit gesunden Mahlzeiten Geniessen Sie gesunde Mahlzeiten in unserer Kantine zu fairen Preisen. Teamanlässe und Events Ihr Engagement macht es uns möglich. Das wollen wir gemeinsam mit Ihnen feiern. Unsere Weihnachtsfeiern, Sommerpartys, Sportveranstaltungen und Teamevents bieten die besten Gelegenheiten dazu. descriptionByLocale.it:
Are you passionate about delivering excellent customer service and keeping processes running smoothly? As a Spare Parts Specialist, you will be the key link between our customers and internal teams, including Technical Advisors and Product Master Data Specialists.
In this role, you will coordinate all activities related to spare parts quotation and order processes. Your goal will be to provide customers with accurate, high-quality quotations as quickly as possible, ensuring a seamless and efficient experience from request to order. Aufgaben: • Receive and review customer requests: Accept and evaluate customer inquiries for service-related offerings (e.g. spare parts). Ensure requests are complete and determine appropriate next steps. • Initiate and prepare quotations in ERP (e.g., SAP): Create and process quotations for various customer requirements within the relevant system, ensuring accurate entry of all relevant information. • Communicate effectively with customers: Manage communications with customers regarding their requests and quotations, answering questions, clarifying details, and managing expectations throughout the process. • Complete technical and commercial details: gather, verify, and input all necessary technical specifications and commercial terms to ensure comprehensive and precise quotations. • Ensure efficient information flow: Collect and provide all necessary information and supporting documentation to streamline processing by internal specialists and stakeholders. Anforderungen: • Diploma from upper secondary school in an electrical or mechanical field or equivalent education through other educational paths • Experience with SAP or similar ERP systems • Highly structured, detail-oriented, and conscientious way of working, ability to use time and resources efficiently • Fluent in the local language and English Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Bühler technologies touch billions of people every day by enabling safe food and sustainable mobility. One billion people travel in vehicles with parts produced using Buhler equipment. With this global relevance, we transform today's challenges into sustainable, scalable, and profitable solutions.
The Department Manager Application Technology NAM leads the regional Application Technology function for Die Casting in North America, serving as the primary liaison for advanced process support from initial casting concepts through finished products. This role is part of the Global Die Casting Application Technology organization and partners with Sales, Quotation, Engineering, Customer Service, and Global Product Management to deliver best-in-class technical guidance, process optimization, and training that drives customer success and business growth. Aufgaben: • Lead, develop, and mentor the North American Application Technology team; build capabilities, succession plans, and a culture of safety, quality, and continuous improvement in close collaboration with the Global Application Technology team • Own the regional application strategy and roadmap aligned to global product strategy; translate market and customer insights into actionable requirements for Product Management • Collaborate with customers on DFM (Design for Manufacturability) to optimize casting designs and reduce total cost of ownership • Proactively drive HPDC applications for future automotive platforms by supporting OEMs in early design and development of future body-in-white, powertrain, battery and chassis components • Co-develop with customers their manufacturing quality framework, including quality standards, process control plans, operational standards for die and equipment maintenance, in-process operations, and post-processing • Support strategic key accounts with process optimization plans and productivity improvement programs • Participate in the proposal engineering process for customer opportunities by defining process/part flow, machine & peripheral equipment requirements, & creating customized customer presentations tailored to the opportunity • Drive revenue development across the local team, in addition to involving the global team, by proactively initiating opportunities and responding to customer requests for part development, process support, trials, and training - converting technical engagements into reoccurring turnover opportunities • Keep in contact with leading universities in the field of HPDC in the NAM region • DC technology scouting: Identify emerging technologies that might expand the application of HPDC and/or improve current HPDC production • Represent Bühler at industry events, technical conferences and seminars, as a subject-matter expert. • Works cross-functionally with Sales and Customer Service to lead operational efforts for Bühler Service Agreements and all other support opportunities to build revenue streams • Financial targets: Setting of and achievement of annual budgets including: • NAM applications and training budget (OR, TO and DB1) • NAM cost budget and cost center coverage Anforderungen: Required Skill and Experience: • Bachelor's degree in engineering or other equivalent training or experience • Deep understanding of high-pressure die casting process and machinery, automation, peripherals (spray systems, ladlers, extractors, thermal control, etc) • Proven experience improving casting quality, yield, cycle time, and OEE through process optimization and data-driven problem solving. • Demonstrated leadership experience managing technical teams and cross-functional initiatives. • Excellent communication skills (written, verbal, and presentation) with the ability to influence at all organizational levels and within customer hierarchies. • Strong customer relationship management and consultative skills. • Highly developed computer skills in Microsoft 365 Preferred Skill and Experience • Experience with Bühler die casting solutions or comparable OEM / Tier 1 experience • Knowledge of die design fundamentals, thermal management, lubricants, and alloy behavior (e.g., Al, Mg, Zn). • Experience with simulation, process monitoring, and analytics tools (e.g., Flow3D, Magmasoft,). • Experience in a global matrix organization a plus. • Leadership skills in local and international environments • Ability to work accurately and reliably under pressure • Coaching of employees in professional and personal development • Strong leadership personality and sense for people development • Target and results oriented • Openness, teamwork, flexibility • Above average personal commitment, independence and readiness for action • Multicultural understanding and sensitivity Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

The Service Agreements Regional Partner is responsible for driving the growth and execution of service agreements across Southeast Asia. This role partners closely with the Sales organization to expand Bühler's service portfolio by identifying opportunities, developing tailored contractual solutions, and securing long-term service agreements. The position plays a critical role in defining commercial structures, ensuring operational excellence, and delivering customer success through strong contractual partnerships. Aufgaben:
• Take full ownership of the assigned portfolio of service agreements (e.g., Remote Services, Inspection, and Maintenance), ensuring delivery excellence and high customer satisfaction.
• Develop and lead a regional support structure, including quotation management, contract delivery, and back-office operations.
• Act as the primary point of contact for all contractual service matters, ensuring timely and effective execution aligned with customer expectations.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Project Execution, Field Service, Spare Parts, and Automation teams to deliver integrated service solutions.
• Drive operational excellence and standardization of service agreement management across the SEA region.
• Oversee contract renewal processes, pricing strategies, and cost control measures to maintain profitability.
• Develop and present integrated service proposals that balance customer needs with business objectives.
• Support the identification, development, quotation, and negotiation of complex service agreements.
• Establish and maintain region-specific cost calculation models in alignment with global guidelines.
• Work with technical, legal, finance, and commercial teams to ensure accurate, compliant, and competitive proposals.
• Maintain comprehensive documentation of quotations, contracts, and handover processes.
• Communicate proactively with stakeholders on proposal status, pricing updates, and contract execution progress.
• Collaborate with global teams to share insights and continuously improve service offerings and customer experience.
• Support the implementation of service frameworks, processes, tools, and best practices within the region Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.
• Minimum 5 years of experience in value-based selling or front-end commercial roles.

• Solid commercial acumen, including pricing, cost management, and risk assessment.
• Excellent stakeholder management, communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
• Fluency in English (written and spoken).

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ensure support of M2M development projects in a technical role based on the existing worldwide
supply chain platform and corporate strategy, supporting until the first serial machines. Strategy
includes logistical concepts as well as risk mitigation approaches for all key components.
Focus on the understanding of technical problems and scouting of solutions and propose them
throughout the different development stages, transferring the know-how from our supply chain
partners as well as screening of new market innovations to be applied on our current or future
products and services.
Proposed solutions should be designed to function, consider manufacturing technologies, and cost
optimised solutions. Furthermore, the role involves design inputs combined with manufacturing
optimisation for single components as well as assemblies. Aufgaben: • Ensure the entire supply chain process as defined in the M2M process during the development and prototyping phase of major equipment and systems, starting from business plan, with the supply chain strategy (supported by senior M2M supply chain engineer) • Interdisciplinary cooperation in cross-divisional contexts, with development and production as well as the associated specialist departments in the project environment, active exchange in the team • Project support for machine developments from supply chain perspective along the phases (BP, CN, DD, IN) including aspect of: Logistic, own and third manufacturing and manufacturing technologies • Support of larger life cycle projects or product transfers, after the market introduction phase • Perform market studies and benchmarks to drive make-or-buy decisions according to total cost principals, coordinated with all relevant stake holders, considering the existing supplier base, the category strategy, the own production strategy, and new potential suppliers • Supplier validation and negotiation of contracts (engineering-, confidentiality-, development-, framework- and quality agreement-contracts) • Consulting in in design aspect such as design to cost, design to manufacturing, design to logistic • Audits of suppliers and sub sequent development of suppliers to reach the defined quality level, responsible for the fulfilment of First Article Inspection • Ensure compliance according to required worldwide norms such as food contact material, electrical norms etc. • Driver for standardization and reduction of complexity. • Exchange with other procurement departments and lead buyers to exchange knowhow and adopt existing solutions • Cost tracking along the phases of the M2M development process. • Ensure risk mitigation with a proper 2nd source strategy • Coordination of development partnerships with suppliers and internal departments. • Maintenance of master data (audit reports, certificates, price lists) in the corresponding systems prior product introduction Anforderungen: • Basic technical education or career • Degree in mechanical and or electrical/software engineering from a university or university of applied sciences • Professional experience in industrial supply chains • Ability to solve problems in a structured way • Technical affinity • Understanding of holistic correlations within the company and business management interrelationship • Negotiation's skills and knowledge of contracts and laws • Experience in execution of development projects • English language skills at C1 and possibly other languages • Proven IT skills (Office, Web applications, internet, SAP, CAD, PDM) • Analytical skills and negotiation skills • Problem structuring and problem-solving skills • Cross-business unit thinking and acting • Presentation skills with positive charisma • Oriented towards the corporate supply chain strategy to secure competitive advantages for the company and the customer • Capability for cost tracking along the M2M process • Selves driven and used to take decisions / ability to work in a team and deal with conflict • Ability as consultant for the project team along the project stages • Customer-oriented mind set, strong and focused implementation skills • Above-average personal commitment • Integrity / assertiveness and descriptionByLocale.it:
The Quotation Specialist supports Customer Service, Outside Sales, and Bühler Group teams by preparing accurate quotations, processing orders, coordinating internal documentation, and supporting customer growth. descriptionByLocale.it:
Buhler Group a Izmir, Türkiye, sta cercando un professionista qualificato e proattivo per unirsi al nostro Service Operations Team come Lead Project Operations. Il ruolo sarà responsabile di coordinare e monitorare i progetti attivi di assistenza e impianti, assicurando l'allineamento tra ingegneria, clienti, team locali con l'esecuzione delle pietre miliari, risoluzione dei problemi, e le attività di installazione e messa in servizio di successo. Il ruolo richiede un forte impegno per la qualità, la consegna on-time, la soddisfazione del cliente e il rispetto delle direttive Bühler e degli standard Ambiente, Salute e Sicurezza (EHS). Aufgaben:
• Coordinare e monitorare tutti i progetti attivi di servizi e impianti all'interno dell'organizzazione locale.
• Agire come l'interfaccia principale tra i clienti, Service Project Engineers, team locali e organizzazioni di progetto Bühler globali.
• Gli ingegneri e l'allineamento dell'ingegneria di supporto durante la pianificazione e l'esecuzione del progetto.
• Traccia le pietre miliari del progetto, i rischi, le deviazioni e i progressi dell'esecuzione, assicurando l'escalation tempestiva e la risoluzione di problemi critici.
• Supporta i Project Manager globali coordinando le risorse locali, la disponibilità del sito, la comunicazione degli stakeholder, l'installazione e le attività di messa in servizio.
• Facilita la collaborazione tra i siti dei clienti, le funzioni ingegneristiche, i team di assistenza e gli stakeholder globali.
• Assicurare il rispetto delle direttive, dei processi e degli standard EHS di Bühler.
• Mantenere le attività di reportistica, documentazione e miglioramento continuo, comprese le lezioni apprese e la pianificazione delle soluzioni di servizio. Anforderungen:
• Laurea in ingegneria meccanica o un campo correlato.
• Minimo 7 anni di esperienza nel coordinamento dei progetti, nelle operazioni di servizio o negli ambienti di ingegneria industriale.
• Esperienza leader o coordinamento delle squadre interfunzionali.
• Forte comprensione tecnica attraverso discipline ingegneristiche e di processo, con la capacità di tradurre la complessità in esecuzione efficace e coordinamento.
• Fluente in inglese e turco (scritto e parlato).
• Forte capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder.
• Volontà di viaggiare e lavorare ore flessibili quando necessario.
• Soggiornare nella regione di Izmir o Manisa. Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo ogni giorno che è stato prodotto con attrezzature Bühler. Un miliardo di persone guidano veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte con le nostre macchine. Bühler si propone di bilanciare l'umanità, la natura e l'economia in ogni decisione, sviluppando soluzioni che sbloccano opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. Ci sforziamo di creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con un focus speciale su soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Pertanto, ci impegniamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e accademia per accelerare l'impatto insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Buhler Group in Izmir, Türkiye, is looking for a skilled and proactive professional to join our Service Operations Team as a Project Operations Lead. The role will be responsible to coordinate and monitor active Service and Plant Projects, ensuring alignment across engineering, customers, local teams along with driving milestone execution, issue resolution, and successful installation and commissioning activities. The role requires a strong commitment to quality, on-time delivery, customer satisfaction, and compliance with Bühler directives and Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) standards.

Aufgaben:
• Coordinate and monitor all active Service and Plant Projects within the local organization.

• Act as the primary interface between customers, Service Project Engineers, local teams, and global Bühler project organizations.

• Guide Service Project Engineers and support engineering alignment during project planning and execution.

• Track project milestones, risks, deviations, and execution progress, ensuring timely escalation and resolution of critical issues.

• Support global Project Managers by coordinating local resources, site readiness, stakeholder communication, installation, and commissioning activities.

• Facilitate collaboration between customer sites, engineering functions, service teams, and global stakeholders.

• Ensure compliance with Bühler directives, processes, and EHS standards.

• Maintain project reporting, documentation, and continuous improvement activities, including lessons learned and service solution planning.

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or a related field.

• Minimum 7 years of experience in project coordination, service operations, or industrial engineering environments.

• Experience leading or coordinating cross-functional teams.

• Strong technical understanding across engineering and process disciplines, with the ability to translate complexity into effective execution and coordination.

• Fluent in English and Turkish (written and spoken).

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Willingness to travel and work flexible hours when required.

• Residing in the Izmir or Manisa region.

Come Ingegnere di Quotazione, sarai responsabile della preparazione di offerte dettagliate per macchine e linee di produzione complete. Il ruolo combina competenze tecniche con la pianificazione, la comunicazione e la negoziazione, permettendo di costruire ogni progetto dal concept alla proposta finale.

Aufgaben:
• Creazione di offerte per progetti di investimento in unità aziendali

• Creazione di concetti, studi di ingegneria e offerte (comprese le attrezzature di processo, ingegneria, installazione, messa in servizio, ecc.)

• Responsabilità tecnica e commerciale della quotazione

• Ottenere offerte da subappaltatori e affiliati

• Creazione della documentazione tenera

• Cooperazione con i responsabili delle vendite, ingegneri meccanici e di automazione e altri ingegneri delle quote

Anforderungen:
• Laurea o Master in ingegneria meccanica o altro campo tecnicamente orientato

• Esperienza professionale nel campo dell'ingegneria di processo potrebbe essere un vantaggio

• Buona conoscenza delle applicazioni di ufficio comuni

• Buona conoscenza di CAD (AutoCAD 3-D) potrebbe essere un vantaggio

• Sistematica, strutturata ed esatta modalità di lavoro

• Completamento indipendente, efficiente e privo di errori del lavoro

• Orientamento del team, capacità di comunicazione e resilienza

• Fluency in inglese è richiesto

• La fluidità in tedesco è un vantaggio

Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo ogni giorno che è stato prodotto con attrezzature Bühler. Un miliardo di persone guidano veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte con le nostre macchine.
Bühler si propone di bilanciare l'umanità, la natura e l'economia in ogni decisione, sviluppando soluzioni che sbloccano opportunità di business sostenibili nei settori alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale.
Ci sforziamo di creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con un focus speciale su soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Pertanto, ci impegniamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e accademia per accelerare l'impatto insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
As a Quotation Engineer, you'll be responsible for preparing detailed offers for machines and full production lines. The role combines technical expertise with planning, communication, and negotiation, allowing you to build each project from concept to final proposal.

Aufgaben:
• Creation of offers for investment projects across business units

• Creation of concepts, engineering studies and offers (including process equipment, engineering, installation, commissioning, etc.)

• Technical and commercial responsibility of quotation

• Obtaining offers from subcontractors and affiliates

• Creation of the tender documentation

• Cooperation with sales managers, mechanical and automation engineers and other quotation engineers

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor or Master degree in mechanical engineering or other technically oriented field

• Professional experience in the field of process engineering might be an advantage

• Good knowledge of common office applications

• Good knowledge of CAD (AutoCAD 3-D) might be an advantage

• Systematic, structured and exact way of working

• Independent, efficient and error-free completion of the work

• Team orientation, communication skills and resilience

• Fluency in English is required

• Fluency in German is an advantage

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Als Quotation Engineer sind Sie für die Erstellung detaillierter Angebote für Maschinen und vollständige Produktionslinien verantwortlich. Die Rolle kombiniert technisches Fachwissen mit Planung, Kommunikation und Verhandlung, so dass Sie jedes Projekt vom Konzept bis zum endgültigen Vorschlag erstellen können.

Aufgaben:
• Erstellung von Angeboten für Investitionsprojekte über Geschäftsbereiche hinweg

• Erstellung von Konzepten, Ingenieurstudien und Angeboten (einschließlich Prozessausrüstung, Engineering, Installation, Inbetriebnahme usw.)

• Technische und kaufmännische Verantwortung des Angebots

• Erhalt von Angeboten von Subunternehmern und verbundenen Unternehmen

• Erstellung der Ausschreibungsunterlagen

• Zusammenarbeit mit Verkaufsleitern, Maschinenbau- und Automatisierungsingenieuren und anderen Angebotstechnikern

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Maschinenbau oder anderen technisch orientierten Bereich

• Berufserfahrung im Bereich Verfahrenstechnik könnte von Vorteil sein

• Gute Kenntnisse über gemeinsame Büroanwendungen

• Gute Kenntnisse von CAD (AutoCAD 3-D) könnten von Vorteil sein

• Systematische, strukturierte und exakte Arbeitsweise

• Unabhängiger, effizienter und fehlerfreier Abschluss der Arbeiten

• Teamorientierung, Kommunikationsfähigkeit und Resilienz

• fließend in Englisch ist erforderlich

• Fließend in Deutsch ist ein Vorteil

Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die mit Bühler-Geräten hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen fahren Fahrzeuge, deren Teile mit unseren Maschinen hergestellt wurden.
Bühler zielt darauf ab, Mensch, Natur und Wirtschaft bei jeder Entscheidung in Einklang zu bringen, indem es Lösungen entwickelt, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsbranche eröffnen.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Stiamo cercando un ingegnere hardware per supportare la transizione a COMOS per la progettazione elettrica. Creare e aggiornare i diagrammi di cablaggio, convalidare i dati e garantire la conformità con gli standard.

Aufgaben:
• Tradurre e standardizzare i diagrammi di cablaggio esistenti dal nostro ambiente legacy in COMOS (migrazione strutturata con regole chiare).

• Norme di protezione e qualità – applicare norme elettriche e regole di progettazione Bühler.

• Costruisci e mantieni il modello/biblioteca COMOS HW per macchine e linee di processo.

• Collabora a stretto contatto con l'ingegneria meccanica e la gestione del progetto per allineare i parametri della macchina con i giusti modelli elettrici.

Anforderungen:
• Eccezionale attenzione ai dettagli e un approccio strutturato in un ambiente basato su database

• Conoscenza solida degli schemi elettrici e dei quadri di controllo/alimentazione

• L'esperienza con qualsiasi software CAD elettrico (ad esempio EPLAN, AutoCAD Electric, RUPLAN, E‐BASE, ecc.) è un vantaggio forte.

• Motivazione per imparare e lavorare con COMOS

• Laurea in ingegneria elettrica (o un campo simile è un vantaggio)

• Inglese a livello comunicativo (Czech è un plus)

descriptionByLocale.en:
We are seeking a Hardware Engineer to support the transition to COMOS for electrical design. You will create and update wiring diagrams, validate data, and ensure compliance with standards.

Aufgaben:
• Translate and standardize existing wiring diagrams from our legacy environment into COMOS (structured migration with clear rules).

• Guard standards & quality – apply electrical norms and Bühler design rules.

• Build and maintain the COMOS HW template/library for machines and process lines.

• Partner closely with Mechanical Engineering and Project Management to align machine parameters with the right electrical templates.

Anforderungen:
• Exceptional attention to detail and a structured approach in a database-driven environment

• Solid knowledge of electrical schematics and control/power panels

• Experience with any electrical CAD software (e.g., EPLAN, AutoCAD Electrical, RUPLAN, E‑BASE, etc.) is a strong advantage

• Motivation to learn and work with COMOS

• Degree in Electrical Engineering (or a similar field is an advantage)

• English at a communicative level (Czech is a plus)

Bühler Leybold Optics steht für innovative Technologien und Wachstum. Als Teil der globalen Bühler Group mit über 13.000 Mitarbeitenden sind wir führender Hersteller von Hightech-Dünnfilm-Vakuumbeschichtungsanlagen. Seit mehr als 150 Jahren entwickeln wir Lösungen für Architekturglas, Brillengläser sowie optische Komponenten in Smartphones, Fahrzeugen und der Medizintechnik.

Für unseren Standort Leipzig suchen wir einen motivierten Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) im Bereich Supply Chain. Sie planen und steuern unsere Supply Chain und tragen so zu einem reibungslosen Projektablauf bei. Wenn Sie Einsatzbereitschaft, Freundlichkeit und Freude an neuen Herausforderungen mitbringen, freuen wir uns auf Sie.

Lassen Sie uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen. Aufgaben: Als Supply Chain Manager (m/w/d) übernehmen Sie eine zentrale Rolle in unserem Leipziger Team und gestalten aktiv die Effizienz unserer Supply Chain mit: • Verantwortung für die Produktionsplanung und -steuerung inklusive aller Supply-Chain-Aktivitäten am Standort • Planung und Steuerung von Montage- und Fertigungsaufträgen • Pflege und Optimierung von Arbeitsplänen, Forecasts, Lageraufträgen und Mindestbeständen • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Bereichen Einkauf, Produktion und Logistik • Kontinuierliche Optimierung von Prozessen und Schnittstellen in der gesamten Supply Chain • Perspektivisch Übernahme weiterer Verantwortung bis hin zur Teamleitung Anforderungen: • Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung oder Studium (idealerweise Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder vergleichbar) • Fundierte Berufserfahrung in Supply Chain, Produktionsplanung, -steuerung oder Disposition • Idealerweise Branchenerfahrung im Maschinen- und Anlagenbau sowie Kenntnisse im Supply Chain Management • Gute ERP-Kenntnisse (vorzugsweise SAP) und sehr sichere MS-Office-Kenntnisse (insbesondere Excel und Power BI von Vorteil) • Fließende Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift • Strukturierte, selbstständige und teamorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie hohe Einsatzbereitschaft Wir bieten: Teamanlässe und Events Ihr Engagement macht es uns möglich. Das wollen wir gemeinsam mit Ihnen feiern. Unsere Weihnachtsfeiern, Sommerpartys, Sportveranstaltungen und Teamevents bieten die besten Gelegenheiten dazu. Interkulturelles Arbeitsumfeld Der Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg ist unsere vielfältige Belegschaft aus mehr als 100 Nationen und unsere inklusive Kultur. Berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung Wir bieten ein breites Spektrum an Lernmöglichkeiten, wie Videos, Online-Schulungen, Präsenzschulungen und Webinare mit kurzen, relevanten, ansprechenden, personalisierten und mobilen Formaten. Vielfältiger und integrativer Arbeitsplatz Wir fördern eine inklusive Kultur, die unsere globale Vielfalt wertschätzt. Respekt und Empathie sorgen dafür, dass sich alle sicher fühlen und ihr Bestes geben können. Öffentliche und private Anbindung Unser Standort bietet eine hervorragende Anbindung an die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel und bequeme Parkplätze, die Ihnen das tägliche Pendeln erleichtern. descriptionByLocale.it:
Per il nostro laboratorio analitico stiamo cercando una personalità impegnata e curiosa per uno stage nel campo dell'analisi fisica. In questo ruolo versatile, ci supporterete nella caratterizzazione dei prodotti alimentari e dei materiali tecnici e otterrete interessanti approfondimenti sui metodi di analisi moderni come le dimensioni delle particelle, la viscosità, il colore, la texture e le analisi termiche. Essi lavorano precisamente sulla preparazione del campione, la valutazione e l'interpretazione dei risultati di misura e contribuiscono a rispondere alle domande tecnologiche. Sarete in scambio con il nostro team di laboratorio, partner interni e clienti e può contribuire le vostre abilità analitiche per progetti di sviluppo e svilupparli ulteriormente. Compiti:
• Essi forniscono servizi analitici per la caratterizzazione dei materiali alimentari e tecnici
• Parlano di domande e analisi con clienti, clienti e partner commerciali
• Eseguono analisi di routine come dimensioni delle particelle, viscosità, colore, texture e analisi termiche
• Preparano campioni, valutano i risultati, interpretano i risultati e producono report scritti
• Essi sviluppano inoltre metodi fisici e supportano in modo indipendente le sottozone nei progetti di sviluppo Requisiti
• Laurea in ingegneria o scienze naturali, idealmente in ingegneria meccanica di processo, scienze alimentari o chimica fisica
• Metodo di analisi preciso e persistente
• Divertimento di lavorare insieme in una squadra
• Il pensiero analitico e l'interesse per le questioni tecniche e scientifiche
• Buone capacità di comunicazione in tedesco e inglese, sia orale che scritta Offriamo: Ristorante personale VIVA Offriamo ai nostri dipendenti un menu di fitness giornaliero da 9.00 CHF. Concetto di mobilità attraente Offriamo un OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Half-Tax per 365 CHF + 400CHF credito di trasporto pubblico e un attraente abbonamento di prima classe o parcheggio gratuito. Porta salute Siamo impegnati nella prevenzione della salute attraverso analisi di laboratorio, massaggi, consigli nutrizionali, fisioterapia, corsi di gruppo e un medico aziendale. Abbonamenti mobili Offriamo condizioni speciali per gli abbonamenti mobili tramite Mobilezone a Sunrise e Swisscom. Attività sportive Promuoviamo lo sport attraverso la formazione di circuiti auto-organizzati e gruppi in esecuzione, nonché buoni per l'aggiornamento e il fitness attivo. Attraente diritto di vacanza Tempo sufficiente per la ricreazione e gli interessi personali - offriamo da 25 a 30 giorni di vacanze all'anno a seconda dell'anno di vita. Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo prodotto nelle piante di Bühler ogni giorno. Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte utilizzando le tecnologie Bühler. Con ogni decisione, Bühler persegue l'obiettivo di conciliare le esigenze dell'economia, delle persone e della natura. In questo modo, sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. Vogliamo innovare per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più veloce insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
For our analytical laboratory we are looking for a committed and curious personality for an internship in the field of physical analytics. In this versatile role, you will support us in the characterization of foodstuffs and technical materials and gain exciting insights into modern analysis methods such as particle size, viscosity, color, texture and thermal analyses. They work precisely on sample preparation, evaluation and interpretation of measurement results and contribute to answering technological questions. You will be in exchange with our laboratory team, internal partners and customers and can contribute your analytical skills to development projects and further develop them. Tasks:
• They provide analytical services for the characterization of food and technical materials
• They discuss questions and analyses with clients, customers and business partners
• They perform routine analyses such as particle size, viscosity, colour, texture and thermal analyses
• They prepare samples, evaluate results, interpret results and produce written reports
• They further develop physical methods and independently support sub-areas in development projects Requirements
• Graduate degree in engineering or natural sciences, ideally in mechanical process engineering, food sciences or physical chemistry
• Precise and persistent method of analysis
• Enjoyment of working together in a team
• Analytical thinking and interest in technical and scientific questions
• Good communication skills in German and English, both oral and written We offer: Staff restaurant VIVA We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9.00 CHF. Attractive mobility concept We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + Half-Tax for 365 CHF + 400CHF public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class subscription or free parking. Health port We are committed to health prevention through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor. Mobile subscriptions We offer special conditions for mobile subscriptions via Mobilezone at Sunrise and Swisscom. Sports activities We promote sport through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for update and active fitness. Attractive holiday entitlement Sufficient time for recreation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of holidays per year depending on the year of life. Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies. With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries. We want to innovate for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

• Sie besprechen Fragestellungen und Analysen mit Auftraggebenden, Kundschaft und Geschäftspartnern
• Sie führen Routineanalysen wie Partikelgrössen-, Viskositäts-, Farb-, Textur- und Thermoanalysen durch
• Sie bereiten Proben vor, werten Ergebnisse aus, interpretieren Resultate und erstellen schriftliche Berichte
• Sie entwickeln physikalische Methoden weiter und unterstützen selbständig Teilbereiche in Entwicklungsprojekten Anforderungen:
• Studienabschluss im Bereich Technik oder Naturwissenschaften, idealerweise in mechanischer Verfahrenstechnik, Lebensmittelwissenschaften oder physikalischer Chemie
• Präzise und ausdauernde Arbeitsweise bei der Durchführung von Analysen
• Freude an der Zusammenarbeit im Team
• Analytisches Denken und Interesse an technischen sowie naturwissenschaftlichen Fragestellungen

descriptionByLocale.it:
Lassen Sie uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen. Aufgaben: • Sie forschen zusammen mit der TU Darmstadt im Rahmen einer möglichen Promotion mit Methoden des Maschinellen Lernens an innovativen Algorithmen, die der präzisen Überwachung und Steuerung von Prozessen in Hochvakuum-Beschichtungsmaschinen für Anwendungen in der Präzisionsoptik- und Halbleiterfertigung dienen • Sie verschmelzen Methoden des Maschinellen Lernens und der Regelungstechnik zur Steigerung der Leistungsfähigkeit und Genauigkeit von Überwachungssystemen • Sie legen neue Grundlagen für die Prozesskontrolle in diesem zukunftsträchtigen Arbeitsgebiet bei einem Weltmarktführer • Sie kooperieren an der TU Darmstadt mit dem Fachgebiet Control and Cyber-Physical Systems • Sie veröffentlichen Ihre Forschungsergebnisse in wissenschaftlichen Fachzeitschriften und Präsentationen auf internationalen Konferenzen Anforderungen: • Sie haben ein abgeschlossenes (universitäres) Master- oder Diplomstudium mit hervorragenden Leistungen in Elektrotechnik, Technischen Kybernetik, Mechatronik, Verfahrenstechnik, Data Science, Informatik, Mathematik oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet • Sie verfügen über Erfahrungen im Bereich des Maschinellen Lernens, der Regelungstechnik/Automatisierungstechnik und dynamischen Systemen • Sie besitzen sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch und/oder Deutsch Wir bieten: Moderner Arbeitsplatz mit bester technischer Ausstattung Arbeiten Sie an einem modernen Arbeitsplatz, der mit den neuesten technischen Hilfsmitteln ausgestattet ist, um Ihre Produktivität und Innovation zu fördern. Interkulturelles Arbeitsumfeld Der Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg ist unsere vielfältige Belegschaft aus mehr als 100 Nationen und unsere inklusive Kultur. Berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung Wir bieten ein breites Spektrum an Lernmöglichkeiten, wie Videos, Online-Schulungen, Präsenzschulungen und Webinare mit kurzen, relevanten, ansprechenden, personalisierten und mobilen Formaten. Mitarbeitendenvorteile und Rabatte Geniessen Sie eine Vielzahl von Mitarbeitendenvorteilen und Ermässigungen, die Ihren Alltag erleichtern. Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und erfahren Sie mehr. Betriebliche Altersvorsorge oder vermögenswirksame Leistungen Profitiere von unserer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge oder vermögenswirksamen Leistungen – für eine sichere Zukunft! titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire de compte de vente - Wheat & Rye

descriptionByLocale.it:
Join our dynamic team as a Sales Account Manager and become a key player in shaping the future of the grain industry! In this role, you'll be driving the promotion and sales of Bühler's innovative Wheat and Rye equipment across the US territory. Your mission will be to craft and execute sales strategies, engage with both existing and potential clients, and uncover their unique needs to deliver tailored solutions. You'll spearhead the development of both existing and new business opportunities while gathering invaluable market insights. If you're passionate about sales and ready to take on exciting challenges, we want you to be part of our journey towards transforming the industry! Aufgaben:
• Direct sales, promoting and selling the Buhler equipment and related equipment in a defined geography
• Develop and implement a sales plan for market and account coverage
• Prospecting, identifying new customers and working with existing owners to ensure that Buhler machinery is top of mind for all new projects
• Manages and maintains assigned accounts and key accounts
• Fosters customer relationships
• Develops and establishes new accounts
• Customer contact, collecting information, negotiating contracts
• Communicates and participates in solving problems related to customer orders or concerns
• Collects market data (customer and competition) that show the need of the businesses and industries within the territory
• Generating enquiries, filling out internal RFQ's and presenting quotes and proposals to the customer
• Close sales to meet or exceed a sales quota
• Attend trade shows as required, attend customer FATs, and travel to Europe as required
• Attend trainings in Europe as needed
• File customer contact reports, call reports and other pertinent information in a CRM
• Other duties as assigned Anforderungen:
• Bachelors Degree in Business, Engineering or equivalent
• Background in Food/Agriculture industry strongly preferred
• Strong mechanical/technical acumen desired
• 5+ years selling capital goods to the food industry
• Attention to detail
• Excellent organization, interpersonal communication skills and relationship building skills to effectively work with a variety of people and personalities; able to communicate clearly and effectively in person and in writing internally and externally
• Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite
• Strong market and commercial awareness
• Ability to build relationships internally and externally while working across time zones and cultures
• A sales leader who can inspire others
• Experience in key account management and directing key account sales teams
• Interpersonal - considers the needs and feelings of others and appropriately responds to different situations
• Maintains discipline, recommending and administering corrective action according to company policy and procedures
• Advanced MS Office skills: Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook
• Oral and Written Communication - presents information, analysis, and ideas in writing in a clear and concise manner; speaks clearly so that others can hear and understand what is being said
• Speaks and understands English, German and/or Spanish a plus
• Domestic and international travel 65% of time which may include long hours and non-traditional work schedules Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Define system requirements and develop complete system solution on time, within budget, and in line with Bühler's quality, design, and EHS standards. The aim is to achieve a high level of customer satisfaction and risk mitigation. A System Engineer further details the functional requirements set by the process engineer and serves as the contact for other Bühler engineering disciplines and elaborate base for automation. The systems engineer “build the bridge” between the functional (Process, HW engineering) and the physical design (3D design and Installation Engineering). Aufgaben:
• Review the work package to ensure it meets process requirements and scope, identify deviations and risks, and propose mitigation actions.
• Help prepare project deliverables and estimate the needed engineering hours for the needed activities.
• Ensure that all interfaces with other engineering disciplines are coordinated in line with the assigned work package and establish effective interdisciplinary communication.
• Set up Site Structure with the plant, Line, Area and Function Groups. Define the necessary request objects on unit and sub-unit level.
• Defining Real Devices for all the objects within the Site structure incl. Location Structure, Customer Description and link to PCE Requests.
• Responsible for the definition and quality of all necessary attributes and data for the hand over to the automation department of small to medium plants. (E.g. Emergency System specification, safety relevant indication, pre-wiring information, interlocks)
• Ensure compliance with process requirements and maintain sizing calculations and functional requirements for specifying third-party equipment and piping.
• Visualize the data with different level of degree on PFD and PIDs according Bühler standards.
• Ensure that the arrangement and the piping routing correspond to the process requirements.
• Resolve questions or problems that occur during the design and manufacturing as well as during installation and commissioning and prepare as-built documentation.
• Record any project deviations, technical issues and product improvements in the Bühler CAQ system or via ticket to service desk.
• Capture return of experience and best practice, apply lessons learned to all templates Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Engineering, or equivalent
• Proven ability to work in a matrix organization
• Good interpersonal and teamwork skills
• Good problem solving skills
• Basic knowledge in CAD tool
• Proficiency in English language Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. • Startprämie 500, - Euro + zusätzliche Prämien für deine guten Leistungen
• Ausbildungsvergütung bis zu 1.410, - Euro pro Monat

• Spannende Azubi-Projekte und Ausflüge

Lass uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.

Aufgaben:
• Find and develop sales opportunities for Bühler solutions.
• Maintain existing customer relationships and help grow the customer base.
• Visit customers and prospects to understand their needs and promote solutions.
• Actively promote Bühler's products and services, especially Short Cycle Business and Customer Service offerings
• Monitor the market and share feedback, customer insights, and sales intelligence.
• Prepare for and carry out sales negotiations.
• Keep customer, contact, lead, and opportunity data updated in the CRM system.
• Support revenue and profit generation within the assigned area. Anforderungen:
• A university degree in economics, engineering, or a related field is desirable.
• Good written and spoken English.
• Apprenticeship in sales, technical, or commercial work is a plus.
• Industry knowledge of the Bühler portfolio relevant to the business area is expected.
• Experience using sales IT tools is required.
• Experience in digital selling is desirable.
• Previous experience in technical departments is an advantage. Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Prendere un ruolo chiave nella formazione globale di Bühler Finance & Controling. Come proprietario di prodotti esperto, si guida processo e progettazione di soluzioni su SAP S/4HANA, che agisce come il integratore tra Finance & Controling e i nostri team aguzza. Migliorate continuamente le funzionalità e spingete il nostro panorama Finance & Controling verso l'eccellenza. Aufgaben:
• Guidate come parte del team globale di agile, lo sviluppo di soluzioni end-to-end per la contabilità, il controllo, il Tesoro, la fiscalità e la gestione dei viaggi
• assicurate la consegna continua del valore in una configurazione SAFe, con OKR chiari e risultati misurabili

descriptionByLocale.it:
Bühler Leybold Optics steht für innovative Technologien und stetiges Wachstum. Als Teil der Bühler Group, einem weltweit agierenden Maschinenbaukonzern mit über 13.000 Mitarbeitenden, sind wir einer der Marktführer im Bereich Hightech-Dünnfilm-Vakuumbeschichtungsanlagen. Seit mehr als 150 Jahren bieten wir unseren Kunden ein breites Angebot an Anlagen für die Beschichtung von Brillengläsern, optischen Komponenten in Smartphones, Autos, Medizintechnik Kameras, Head Up Displays von Autos und vielem mehr. Unserem internationalen Team gelingt es tagtäglich neue Maßstäbe zu setzen und komplexe Projekte erfolgreich umzusetzen.

Wir suchen einen motivierten Werkstudenten (m/w/d), der unser Team in Alzenau tatkräftig unterstützt. Unser Wunschkollege (m/w/d) besticht durch Engagement und Zuverlässigkeit und scheut sich nicht davor eigenständig Aufgaben zu übernehmen.

Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Aufgaben: • Du unterstützt bei Innovationsprojekten und arbeitest mit an Abteilungsprojekten • Du erstellst detaillierte und modulare Wartungspläne für Anlagenkomponenten und Gesamtanlagen • Du unterstützt bei der Integration neuer Anlagen in unsere digitale Toolbox • Du hilfst bei der systematischen Erfassung, Kategorisierung und Anbindung von Ersatz- und Verschleißteilen neuer Anlagen für unsere myBühler platform Anforderungen: • Du bist immatrikulierter Student (m/w/d) im Bereich Maschinenbau, Mechatronik, Produktionstechnik, Wirtschaftsingenieurswesen oder vergleichbar • Du hast Erfahrung im Umgang mit MS-Office und idealerweise erste Kenntnisse in SAP • Du besitzt sehr gute Englischkenntnisse, gute Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil • Du verfügst über eine strukturierte, selbstständige Arbeitsweise und hast Interesse an Digitalisierung Wir bieten: Moderner Arbeitsplatz mit bester technischer Ausstattung Arbeiten Sie an einem modernen Arbeitsplatz, der mit den neuesten technischen Hilfsmitteln ausgestattet ist, um Ihre Produktivität und Innovation zu fördern. Interkulturelles Arbeitsumfeld Der Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg ist unsere vielfältige Belegschaft aus mehr als 100 Nationen und unsere inklusive Kultur. Berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung Wir bieten ein breites Spektrum an Lernmöglichkeiten, wie Videos, Online-Schulungen, Präsenzschulungen und Webinare mit kurzen, relevanten, ansprechenden, personalisierten und mobilen Formaten. Mitarbeitendenvorteile und Rabatte Geniessen Sie eine Vielzahl von Mitarbeitendenvorteilen und Ermässigungen, die Ihren Alltag erleichtern. Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und erfahren Sie mehr. • You train customer personnel and internal employees in milling technology, both at the Milling Academy and on-site through hands-on training
• You create, update, and maintain training materials and course documentation, while continuously familiarizing yourself with new technologies and equipment
• You define and further develop course content together with the team to ensure high-quality and up-to-date training programs
• You support customers and course participants by providing professional guidance, organizing visits and representations, and ensuring a positive overall training experience

• Profound technical expertise in wheat, durum, oat, and corn milling, including detailed knowledge of machinery, aspiration, and pneumatics, complemented by a basic understanding of electrical and automation technology
• Willingness to travel internationally for mill inspections, customer training, and on-site support, combined with the ability to work effectively across different cultures and environments
• Independent, responsible, and motivating personality with strong teamwork skills, the ability to stay calm under pressure, and a confident and professional presence when representing the company externally
• Strong communication skills in Arabic, French and English, both written and spoken; additional languages such as German or Spanish are an advantage Wir bieten: Attractive vacation entitlement Enough time for relaxation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of vacation per year depending on age. Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
